jobs.title: Fullstack .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving

Een positieve toekomst voor iedereen daar werken we bij Sopra Steria aan. Met meer dan 56.000 collega's in 30 landen zijn we Europa's toonaangevende leverancier van digitale oplossingen. Wij weten als geen ander dat het niet alleen technologie is die transformatie aanstuurt. Het zijn mensen die de kern van verandering vormen. Daarom zijn het mensen die centraal staan in alles wat we doen en bieden we een ondersteunende en inclusieve omgeving waar iedereen zowel individueel als in teamverband kan uitblinken.

The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together.

Vacatureomschrijving

Heb jij een passie voor Microsoft-technologie en wil je jouw backend-expertise combineren met de dynamiek van moderne frontend-frameworks? Binnen de Microsoft Area van Sopra Steria werk je samen met ervaren engineers aan complexe, impactvolle projecten voor klanten binnen defensie, de publieke sector, financiële dienstverlening en de industrie. Hier combineer je end-to-end vakmanschap met échte maatschappelijke impact en maak je dagelijks het verschil!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Fullstack Developer werk je in multidisciplinaire DevOps-teams aan complexe IT-vraagstukken. Je bent de brug tussen een ijzersterke .NET backend en een intuïtieve, moderne frontend. Je ontwikkelt toekomstbestendige oplossingen en levert code waar je trots op bent: schoon, onderhoudbaar, goed getest en klaar voor de toekomst.

Kwaliteit staat voorop. Geen snelle fixes, maar doordachte oplossingen. Je denkt actief mee over software-architectuur, designkeuzes en technische standaarden, waarbij je zowel de logica in de backend als de performance in de frontend bewaakt.

Een voorbeeld van een opdracht kan het volgende inhouden:

Migraties & Modernisering: Een verouderde Microsoft .NET applicatie (met bijvoorbeeld .NET Framework 4.8) migreren naar .NET 8, en tegelijkertijd de user interface herbouwen in een modern JavaScript-framework zoals Angular, React of Vue.
Cloud & Architectuur: Een nieuwe Azure-omgeving inrichten met Infrastructure as Code (IaC), waarbij je microservices in .NET naadloos laat communiceren met een schaalbare frontend.
Security & Optimalisatie: MFA implementeren in een bestaande applicatie en de API-performance optimaliseren om de laadtijden in de browser drastisch te verkorten.

Functie-eisen

Wat neem jij mee?

Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring als .NET Developer, met sterke kennis van .NET (C#) en moderne .NET Core/.NET 8 architecturen en bij voorkeur ervaring met Azure DevOps en/of Github. Werk jij er nog niet mee? Dan sta jij ervoor open om dit snel eigen te maken.
Naast een sterke backend (.NET)-basis, beschik jij ook over aantoonbare kennis van en ervaring met ten minste één modern JavaScript-framework (zoals Angular, React of Vue).
Ervaring met werken in een Agile/Scrum-omgeving en gewend om samen te werken binnen een DevOps-team.
Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Informatica (of vergelijkbaar), communiceert goed in het Nederlands en werkt graag samen in een team waar kennisdeling centraal staat.
Jij hebt een positieve, oplossingsgerichte mindset en vindt het belangrijk om kwalitatief goede, onderhoudbare code te schrijven.
Jij blijft jezelf ontwikkelen, volgt technologische ontwikkelingen actief, bent gemotiveerd om certificeringen te behalen en het lijkt jou gaaf om onderdeel te worden van onze Microsoft Community waarin kennisdeling centraal staat.

Aanvullende informatie

Dit krijg je van ons!

Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

Een vast contract en een salaris tussen de €4.000,- en €6.000,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week, dienstverband minimaal 32 uur).
Bij Sopra Steria vinden we gelijke beloning voor gelijkwaardig werk belangrijk. Daarom bepalen we je salaris op basis van objectieve criteria zoals ervaring, kennis, competenties en verantwoordelijkheden. Zo zorgen we voor een eerlijke en transparante beloning die past bij jouw achtergrond en de impact van je rol.
Vakantiegeld van 8%;
Een winstdelingsregeling met een target-uitkering van 8% van het bruto (parttime) jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van bedrijfsresultaten;
Een mobiliteitsregeling met de keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto of een alternatieve vervoersregeling, passend bij jouw situatie;
27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen aan- of te verkopen;
Flexibele hybride werkomstandigheden: thuis, op kantoor of bij de klant, afhankelijk van de functie en de mogelijkheden binnen opdrachten;
Een thuiswerkpakket met laptop, telefoon en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding;
Volop mogelijkheden voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling via trainingen, certificeringen, kennissessies en inspirerende events;
Diverse sociale activiteiten met collega’s, van informele borrels tot sportieve en inhoudelijke evenementen;
Mogelijkheden voor fiscaal vriendelijke aflossing van jouw studieschuld;
Een uitgebreid aanbod aan voordelen via ons cafetariamodel, waaronder een fietsregeling, sportabonnementen, zonnepanelen en collectieve verzekeringen;
Een pensioenregeling met een werkgeversbijdrage en de mogelijkheid om vrijwillig aanvullende pensioenopbouw te realiseren.
Bij Sopra Steria geloven we in continue groei. Je krijgt de ruimte om je verder te specialiseren binnen Microsoft-technologie en certificeringen te behalen én te onderhouden, zoals AI-200 en AZ-400.

Wat ons écht onderscheidt?

Bij ons draait het niet alleen om projecten, maar ook om jouw groei als Microsoft professional. Je krijgt een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan, begeleiding van ervaren specialisten en alle ruimte om door te groeien naar een volgende stap, technisch én professioneel.

Met meer dan 180 Microsoft-specialisten werk je in één van de grootste Microsoft-communities van Nederland. Van .NET en software-architectuur tot Power Platform, Data & AI en Security kennis is hier overal. We hebben meerdere MVP’s en MCT’s in huis en zijn trots Microsoft Solution Partner.

Kennisdeling en plezier. Maandelijkse track-meetings, inspiratiesessies en een actief Inspirator- en accelerator programma helpen je om jezelf én anderen beter te maken. En natuurlijk bezoeken we samen toonaangevende conferenties zoals Future Tech en maken we ook tijd voor teamuitjes die je niet snel vergeet.

Klaar om te groeien?
 Klaar voor een nieuwe uitdaging bij een bedrijf dat net zo in beweging is als jij? Neem contact op met Mathilda van Delden: mathilda.vandelden@soprasteria.com of solliciteer direct. We kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten!

______

Sopra Steria is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

jobs.title: .NET Developer – Productieomgeving - Den Haag
Backend Developer
jobs.description:
What is your role?

At Lely, we develop technology that helps shape the future of sustainable dairy farming. From robotic systems to digital farm management solutions, software plays a crucial role in creating reliable, scalable products that support farmers worldwide.

As a Backend Developer, you contribute to the digital backbone behind our robotic ecosystem. You work on systems that enable reliable communication, data processing, and robot management at scale. Your work directly supports innovations that improve animal welfare, farm efficiency, and sustainable food production.

In this role, you collaborate closely with software engineers, product owners, and other stakeholders in multidisciplinary Scrum teams. Together, you design and improve scalable backend services, translate business needs into technical solutions, and continuously strengthen the quality, performance, and security of our platforms.

Your main responsibilities

Designing, developing, and maintaining robust and scalable backend services and RESTful APIs.
Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to translate functional requirements into sustainable technical solutions.
Contributing to the development of future-proof platform modules and ensuring smooth integration with existing systems.
Improving software quality, maintainability, and performance through testing, refactoring, and continuous improvement.
Helping ensure secure and reliable systems by contributing to authentication, authorization, and cybersecurity best practices.

Apply now

What is your experience?

You are a software Developer who enjoys building reliable systems and solving technical challenges together with others. You combine a structured and analytical mindset with curiosity and a strong sense of ownership. You feel comfortable working in a multidisciplinary environment where software contributes directly to robotics and digital innovation.

You will likely recognize yourself in much of the following:

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
At least 3 years of experience in backend software development.
Experience with C#, JavaScript or TypeScript, and modern backend frameworks such as ASP.NET Core or ExpressJS.
Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and building scalable backend systems.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and cloud or container technologies such as Azure, Docker, or Kubernetes.
An interest in software quality, testing, and secure development practices, including authentication and authorization concepts.
Familiarity with cyber security (authentication, authorization, threat modeling).
Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across disciplines and translate requirements into practical solutions.
A self-starting personality. You are someone who doesn’t wait for instructions and who starts designing and prototyping to prove whether concepts work or not.

What you can expect from us

Working at Lely means contributing to sustainable progress within one of the most innovative organizations in the Netherlands. You help make the agricultural sector more futureproof, and we ensure you have the space, resources, and support to do so.

An international work environment that values collaboration, initiative, and diverse perspectives.
A culture that encourages learning, experimentation, and ownership of ideas.
Excellent employment conditions, including up to 8 weeks of vacation per year and a strong pension scheme.
A Salary range of €5,000 - €7,100 gross per month, with clear opportunities for growth within the scale.
Full ownership of your own development, with access to a wide range of courses through the Lely Academy.
Daily access to outstanding sports facilities at the Lely Campus: an indoor gym, outdoor padel courts, basketball and volleyball courts, table tennis, and table football. You can join Hyrox workouts or sign up for personal training and challenge your colleagues during an active break.
Fresh coffee and tea from our own barista (with milk from our own farm) and a healthy, affordable company restaurant.

Work-life balance

A healthy work-life balance thanks to our hybrid working policy: you work at least three days a week on Campus, with flexible hours and plenty of opportunity to spend additional time onsite (between 06:00 and 20:00).
A free shuttle bus that takes you to and from the metro station in Maassluis, ensuring your workday starts and ends smoothly.
And of course: we love to celebrate! Whether it’s an anniversary or the annual Christmas party. At Lely, we know how to do it. For an impression of our events, take a look at this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6WA3e0WHbxE

We are also proud that our vision and efforts have been recognized with the Rotterdam Entrepreneurs Award 2025.

Recruitment & selection agency, consultancy, and/or staffing agency?

We appreciate the interest, but we recruit all our candidates directly. We understand that as intermediaries, you want to present candidates for our great positions and contribute to our ambitions, but this is not how we have set up our recruitment process. This means that all unsolicited profiles offered on Lely vacancies will be treated as direct applications.

About Lely

Founded in 1948, Lely is committed to a sustainable, profitable, and enjoyable future in agriculture. Driven by the challenges faced by farmers and the needs of cows, we develop high-quality robots and data systems that improve animal welfare, flexibility, and productivity on dairy farms. Our mission is to support sustainable food production.

For more than 30 years, we have been a global leader in the sale and service of automated systems for successive generations of dairy farmers. Every day, we inspire our colleagues to offer customers innovative solutions and to be a reliable partner for long-term advice and support. With our state-of-the-art Lely Campus in Maassluis and a global network of dedicated Lely Centers offering customized sales and service, Lely is active in more than fifty countries.

Ozan Arikan

If you can’t find certain information in this vacancy, you can reach out to us via WhatsApp.

Please note that we do not process job applications through WhatsApp due to privacy regulations (GDPR). You can apply via the apply button on this page.

jobs.title: Software Architect Microsoft (.Net & Azure)
jobs.description:
Bij Sogeti werk je als Software Architect Microsoft aan complexe IT-vraagstukken binnen een dynamische en kennisgedreven omgeving. Je bent onderdeel van een community van experts die elkaar versterken, uitdagen en inspireren. We geloven in vakmanschap, kennisdeling en plezier in het werk. Daarom organiseren we regelmatig technische meetups, deep-dive sessies en bieden we volop ruimte voor certificering en persoonlijke groei.

Jouw rol als Software Architect Microsoft

Als Software Architect ben jij de technische sparringpartner voor onze klanten en collega’s. Je ontwerpt en realiseert robuuste en schaalbare architecturen op basis van Microsoft-technologieën, .NET en Azure. Je vertaalt businessdoelen naar technische oplossingen en begeleidt ontwikkelteams in het maken van de juiste designkeuzes. Je werkt aan projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties binnen diverse branches, waarbij je continu schakelt tussen strategie, techniek en teamdynamiek. Je bent in staat om architectuurprincipes helder over te brengen, risico’s te identificeren en mitigaties voor te stellen. Je hebt een sterke visie op softwarekwaliteit, DevOps, cloud-native development en security-by-design. Dankzij jouw ervaring en overtuigingskracht weet je stakeholders mee te nemen in jouw technische keuzes.

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding en minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als Software Architect.
Gedegen kennis van Microsoft-technologieën (.NET, Azure, DevOps, etc.)
Ervaring met het opzetten van softwarearchitecturen en het begeleiden van ontwikkelteams
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en analytisch vermogen
Passie voor technologie en een drive om continu te leren en te verbeteren
Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal op minimaal C1-niveau.

Dit bieden wij jou

   Een dienstverband van 40 uur per week, met flexibele mogelijkheden om parttime te werken.
   Een salaris tussen de E80.000 en E95.000 bruto per jaar (inclusief vakantiegeld en mobiliteitsbudget), exclusief bonus.
   Een flexibel mobiliteitsbudget, met o.a. opties om elektrisch te rijden.
   Hybride werken en een goede werk-privébalans.
   Uitgebreide opleidings- en certificeringsmogelijkheden.
   Flexibiliteit in het ruilen van feestdagen, passend bij jouw persoonlijke voorkeuren.
   26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de optie om extra dagen bij te kopen.
   Uitdagende projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties waarin jouw technische expertise het verschil maakt.
   Toegang tot onze kenniscommunity, meet-ups, hackathons en tech-events. En natuurlijk: ontspanning via game nights, skitrips en meer.

Ben jij nieuwsgierig geworden naar de projecten waar wij dagelijks aan werken en wil jij deel uitmaken van onze actieve Microsoft Community?
Solliciteer nu en ontdek hoe jij het verschil kunt maken! Een PES-screening en assessment maken deel uit van het proces.

jobs.title: Software Security Designer – Cyber Resilience Act / IEC
jobs.description:
At Sioux Technologies, cybersecurity is rapidly becoming a core engineering discipline. Rather than treating security as an afterthought, we help our customers design cyber-resilient products from the earliest system concepts onward.

In this role you help our customers develop cyber-resilient high-tech products that comply with the latest European cybersecurity legislation and industrial security standards.

You work on complex systems in the semiconductor, medical, analytical instrumentation and industrial automation domains, translating cybersecurity requirements into practical software solutions.

What excites you as a Software Security Designer – Cyber Resilience Act / IEC?

From any Sioux office in the Netherlands, you will work in mono-disciplinary and multidisciplinary teams to design, implement and validate secure software that meets regulatory requirements and industry-standard security frameworks.

You enjoy:

Translating a security architecture into software design
Performing software security design reviews and implementing secure-by-design principles.
Supporting threat modelling (STRIDE, OWASP, attack trees, misuse cases).
Performing cybersecurity risk assessments and defining security requirements for embedded and application software.
Implementing authentication, authorization, encryption and secure communication.
Improving software supply chain security (SBOMs, dependency management, vulnerability management).
Developing CRA and IEC 62443 compliant software.

Sounds good so far? We’d love to tell you more…..

Your future workplace

This is what you bring to the table

You combine extensive software engineering experience with deep knowledge of secure product development, helping customers implement security throughout the entire software lifecycle.

To be successful in this role, you have:

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field.
More than 7 years of experience in software development (C++, C#, Java, and/or embedded software) within the medical technology, semiconductor, analytical instrumentation, and/or industrial automation industries.
Demonstrable experience in implementing security requirements for products subject to one or more of the following regulations: CRA, NIS2, and AIA.
Experience with one or more of the following security standards: IEC 62443, IEC 81001, and ISO/IEC 27001.
Experience with threat modeling and vulnerability management (CVE, CVSS, PSIRT).
Experience generating Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) and securing the software supply chain.
Experience with secure coding guidelines (such as CERT, MISRA, and OWASP) and working in Agile, DevOps, and DevSecOps environments.

This is what you can expect in return from Sioux

Flexible 32-40 hour working week, with room to work from home.
A healthy work-life balance is very important to us. We have 28 holidays with an option to acquire an additional 12 holidays.
You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success.
By combining our expertise in software, electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, mathematics and assembly, we make the impossible possible for our customers and get to work on challenging high-tech projects.
You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing.
Personal coaching and a training budget of €6000 per year, so that you can continue to develop yourself.
We also find it important to have fun together. We organize a lot for our employees, from family festivals and sparkling Christmas parties, to inspiring knowledge sessions for the high-tech community.
You will be working at a prime location in the heart of the Brainport region. You will be working on the Sioux Campus and can use our Sioux Labs living room every day for lunch, sports, making music, and sharing your knowledge with colleagues in one of our Tech Labs.

High Tech & High Fun

We can tell you all about the typical Sioux-culture and the high-tech challenging projects. About how you can develop yourself, like nowhere else. But we’d rather have you hear it from our own employees.

Go to testimonials >

If you want to know more about our challenging projects, please click here.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer Azure en Kubernetes
jobs.description:
In het kort

De afdeling Software Services zorgt ervoor dat al onze klanten zelf of via hun adviseur online hun hypotheek kunnen regelen. Wij maken dit mogelijk door het realiseren van maatwerkapplicaties waarmee we onze adviseurs, klanten en medewerkers optimaal kunnen bedienen. Dit doen we met meerdere teams die het DevOps ideaal in de praktijk brengen. Het platformteam is daarin een cruciale factor.

Je werk

We zoeken een software engineer met ervaring met en/of ambities naar platform engineer. In ons platform team tillen we development teams naar een hoger niveau door Infrastructuur as Code, templates, self-service oplossingen en andere resources aan te leveren zodat de teams snel waarde kunnen leveren met hun applicaties op Kubernetes. Ook ontwikkelen we zelf een aantal business gedreven Frontend en Backend applicaties zodat we zelf onze eerste klant zijn. Dit betekent dat we altijd op zoek zijn naar verbeteringen in onze code, stack en kennis. Voor elk teamlid is het blijven leren en verbeteren is daarbij belangrijk. Daar krijg je dan ook elke kans voor. Het is belangrijker dat je oog hebt voor kwaliteit en graag leert dan dat je specifieke tools en technieken al beheerst.

We zijn een gezellig team van specialisten; samen brainstormen en het oplossen van problemen staan bij ons hoog in het vaandel. Daarnaast zijn we een vraagbaak voor collega's uit andere teams en helpen we hen vaak met onze kennis en ideeën. De kennis die je nog niet hebt doe je graag op en nieuwe uitdagingen pak je met beide handen aan. Als deze mindset bij je past, is Team B een grote kans om je kennis en kunde uit te breiden en aan te scherpen.

Werkomgeving

Ons kantoor is gevestigd in Amersfoort, vlak bij het station, en de sfeer op onze afdeling is gezellig en ontspannen. Passie voor je vak, ondernemerschap en vakmanschap vinden wij belangrijk op de afdeling. De cultuur is informeel, wij zijn open naar elkaar, vieren successen en organiseren regelmatig afdelingsuitjes. We zien onze collega's graag 1 of 2 dagen per week op kantoor. De overige dagen werken we vanuit huis. We zoeken iemand met academisch/ HBO opleidings- en werkniveau die beschikbaar is voor 32, 36 of 40 uur. Onze voertaal is Nederlands omdat onze business ook volledig Nederlands opereert.

Je profiel

Je hebt kennis van Kubernetes (liefst AKS); bonuspunten voor ervaring met kubernetes-tooling zoals Istio, Calico, Helm en Prometheus;
Je kunt je door programmeerervaring binnen het Microsoft-domein goed verplaatsen in de behoeften van andere .NET-ontwikkelaars;
Je hebt affiniteit met Platform Engineering;
Je verkent graag nieuwe clouddiensten binnen Azure en weet die op een veilige manier te ontsluiten voor andere ontwikkelaars (en je eigen team);
Je voelt je thuis in de wereld van CI/CD, IaC, pipelines, git en shift-left;
Security, schaalbaarheid en robuustheid van onze oplossingen verlies je niet uit het oog;
Je excelleert in .NET en bouwt daarmee graag nieuwe microservices;
Je bent trots op je werk en presenteert je ideeën en resultaten graag aan andere ontwikkelaars.
Je beschikt over een minimum van B2 Nederlands in woord en geschrift

Wij bieden

Het is voor ons belangrijk om een goede werkgever te zijn. Wij bieden je daarom een functie met impact en uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden die bijdragen aan jouw werkplezier, ontwikkeling en wellbeing.

Daarnaast bieden wij:

Een aantrekkelijk bruto maandsalaris op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. Dit is inclusief vakantiegeld en een flexibel benefit budget.
Een uitstekende pensioenregeling, zodat je goed voorbereid bent voor later.
Flexibiliteit in werken: thuiswerken is mogelijk in overleg met je team en afhankelijk van je functie. Wij regelen een ergonomische thuiswerkplek voor je.
Ruimte voor ontspanning met vijf weken vakantie per jaar, aangevuld met twee verplichte vrije dagen. Daarnaast kun je jaarlijks tot vier extra weken vakantie bijkopen.
Vijf ‘Banking for better days’: extra vrije dagen die je kunt inzetten voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling of vrijwilligerswerk.
Persoonlijke ontwikkeling staat centraal: je ontvangt een ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 per jaar,dat je kunt opsparen tot €3.000.
Een OV-jaarabonnement met gratis openbaar vervoer in heel Nederland voor zakelijk en privégebruik.

Meer informatie over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden en salarisschalen vind je in onze cao die van toepassing is op deze vacature.

Interesse?

Dan ontvangen we graag je cv & motivatiebrief.

Jouw Toekomst: Inclusief, Innovatief en Duurzaam

Bij ABN AMRO geloven we in " Banking for better, for generations to come.
" Gelijke kansen voor iedereen vormen een belangrijk fundament, waarbij we streven naar een inclusieve cultuur waarin alle medewerkers zich gezien, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelen. Onze visie als persoonlijke bank in de digitale tijd
sluit naadloos aan bij de behoefte aan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen, voortkomend uit een divers samenspel van culturen en ervaringen. We richten ons op klantbeleving, duurzaamheid en bouwen aan een toekomstbestendige bank, waarbij we gelijke beloning voor gelijk werk jaarlijks onderzoeken om eerlijke kansen te waarborgen. Sluit je aan bij een bank die vindingrijkheid en ambitie omarmt, en maak samen met ons impact voor een betere toekomst.

Voor een interessant en maatschappelijk relevant Digital Twin-project zijn we op zoek naar een Technisch Architect met een sterke achtergrond in DevOps en Security Architectuur.
Je komt terecht in een lopende samenwerking tussen een grote publieke organisatie en een toonaangevende IT-dienstverlener, waarin gezamenlijk wordt gewerkt aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een toekomstvaste, veilige en schaalbare Digital Twin-omgeving.

Ontwerpen en doorontwikkelen van de technische architectuur van het Digital Twin-platform.

Je werkt in een omgeving waarin verschillende organisaties, disciplines en expertises samenkomen. Juist de samenwerking maakt deze rol interessant: je krijgt de ruimte om vanuit jouw technische expertise richting te geven, maar doet dit samen met ervaren professionals uit verschillende vakgebieden.

jobs.title: EDI Engineer
Research Assistant at the Donders Centre for Cognition: Computational Modelling and Scientific Software
jobs.description:
Are you interested in advanced computational modelling and state-of-the-art scientific software? Join us in creating the Bayesian multiverse: a computational framework for robust statistical analyses, applicable across empirical research domains. The position offers the opportunity to work on the combination of state-of-the-art scientific computing and Bayesian statistics, and to contribute to an open-source scientific software library.

You will be part of a larger project at the Uncertainty in Complex Systems lab (PI: Dr Max Hinne) aimed at learning which statistical and/or computational model is most suited for a provided data set and scientific question. In practice, statistical models contain many arbitrary choices that may (a) have a detrimental effect on what we can learn from it and (b) greatly reduces the reproducibility of scientific research, as different researchers make different decisions. A Bayesian multiverse is a systematic way of reducing these adverse effects and aims to make statistical analyses more robust.

We are looking for a research assistant to contribute to the development of bamojax (Bayesian modelling in JAX), our open-source Python toolbox for Bayesian modelling and model comparison. Throughout your employment, you will have the opportunity to work with others within our group to see what modelling choices they make, and how our new Bayesian multiverse tools can help with this. There will be weekly meetings with the PI to discuss the project's progress and next steps, as well as bi-weekly lab meetings.

You will have two core tasks. The first is to implement advanced methods for Bayesian model comparison in JAX. These techniques will then be used to systematically explore alternative models for user-defined statistical problems. The second task is to construct an efficient search procedure for variants of a given model.

Profile

You have an MSc degree in computer science, data science, AI, applied mathematics, or a related discipline.
You have demonstrable experience with programming in Python and implementing statistical or machine learning algorithms.
You have experience with software development practices such as testing and version control with Git.
You have a solid mathematical background in, for example, probability, statistics, calculus and linear algebra.
You have good communication skills.
You have a passion for improving the scientific process.
Prior experience with Bayesian statistics and/or JAX is a plus.

We offer

We will give you a temporary employment contract of 1 year.
Your salary within salary scale 7 depends on your previous education and number of years of (relevant) work experience. The amounts in the scale are based on a 38-hour working week.
You will receive an 8% holiday allowance and an 8,3% end-of-year bonus.
You will receive extra days off. With full-time employment, you can choose between 30 or 41 days of annual leave instead of the statutory 20.

Additional Employment Conditions

Work and science require good employment practices. This is reflected in Radboud University's primary and secondary employment conditions. You can make arrangements for the best possible work-life balance with flexible working hours, various leave arrangements and working from home. You are also able to compose part of your employment conditions yourself, for example, exchange income for extra leave days and receive a reimbursement for your sports subscription. And of course, we offer a good pension plan. You are given plenty of room and responsibility to develop your talents and realise your ambitions. Therefore, we provide various training and development schemes.

We are

The Donders Institute for Brain, Cognition and Behaviour is a world-class interfaculty research centre that houses more than 700 researchers devoted to understanding the mechanistic underpinnings of the human mind. Research at the Donders Institute is focused around four themes:

Language and communication.
Perception, action and decision-making.
Development and lifelong plasticity.
Natural computing and neurotechnology.

Excellent, state-of-the-art research facilities are available for the broad range of neuroscience research that is being conducted at the Donders Institute. The Donders Institute has been assessed by an international evaluation committee as ‘excellent’ and recognised as a ‘very stimulating environment for top researchers, as well as for young talent’. The Donders Institute fosters a collaborative, multidisciplinary and supportive research environment with a diverse international staff. English is the lingua franca at the Institute.

Practical information and applying

You can apply only via the button below. Address your letter of application to Max Hinne. In the application form, you will find which documents you need to include with your application. We look forward to receiving your application.

The first interviews will take place on Monday 2 November. Any second interview will take place on Thursday 19 November. Prior to the second-round interview, candidates will receive an assignment, which they will be asked to present during the interview.

You will preferably start your employment on 1 January 2027.

We can imagine you're curious about our application procedure. It describes what you can expect during the application procedure and how we handle your personal data and internal and external candidates. If you wish to apply for a non-scientific position with a non-EU nationality, please take notice of the following information.

Do you already work at Radboud University and have questions about making an internal move? Learn more about internal applications.

APIs and events that other Eneco teams can build on with confidence.
Automated, repeatable deployments through Terraform and CI/CD.
The health of what you build: you run it, you monitor it, you improve it ("you build it, you run it").

Here's what you get from us

Work Where Everyone Matters

When you choose a career at Eneco, you choose ambition, growth, and opportunity in an environment where everyone matters. jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer (.NET) (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Staff Backend Engineer – Platform

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there.

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be up to

Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems.
Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently.
Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment.
Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders.
Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence.
Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably.
Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available.
Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents.
Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement.

Some of the challenges waiting for you

Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally).
Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery.
Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch.
Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level.

What you'll bring to the team

8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role.
Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used.
A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team.
Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well).
Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack).
Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function.
Fluent English.

Nice to have

Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong.
Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation).
Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent).
Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams.

What we offer

Culture and growth

A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities.
Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework.
Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency.
Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up.
Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams.

Perks and lifestyle

Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team.
A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany.
Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events.
30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired.
An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options.

Where you'll work from

This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We're also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

Gestalte mit uns die Softwarequalität von morgen!

Die Position ist sowohl in Vollzeit
als auch in Teilzeit
möglich.

Verantwortlichkeiten

Verschiedene Einsatzbereiche wie Automotive, Aerospace, Mobile, Insurance, Medical, Banking, Energy, etc. findest Du interessant und herausfordernd.

Du verfügst über eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative, Selbstständigkeit und eine hohe Lösungskompetenz.
Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mindestens C1-Niveau) und hast gute Englischkenntnisse.

Du verfügst über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes technisches oder naturwissenschaftliches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und hast mindestens 5 Jahre Berufs- und/oder Projekterfahrung im Bereich Software-Testing.
Gängige Testwerkzeuge im Bereich der Testautomatisierung (z.B. OpenText ALM , OpenText Unified Functional Testing, Tosca, Playwright oder Selenium) oder im Bereich der Last- & Performancetests (z.B. Bei Expleo setzen wir auf Teamwork, Offenheit, Transparenz und Wertschätzung. Wir gehen unsere Aufgaben gemeinsam an
Bei uns erwartet dich ein internationales und multikulturelles Team

Man lernt nie aus: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns sehr am Herzen. Wir bieten interne Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und unterstützen dich und deine perspektivischen Ziele

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.

Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.
Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.

A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).

A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.
Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.
Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren’t in the room.
Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable formulating answers and options in high-pressure or contentious situations while maintaining client confidence.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insight and recommendations.
Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.

Experience in an agency, consultancy or in-house marketing transformation environment.
Experience with global or multi-market clients and remote, cross-functional teams.

jobs.title: Client Solutions Director / Solution Design Architect
jobs.description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER
is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.  
As a part of The Brandtech Group
, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions
enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.  
Solution Design Architect (AI / Transformation / Creative Operations)
Language requirement:
fluency in German or Spanish
Location:
Germany (primarily remote) and regular business travel across EMEA
Employment:
18-month FTC with view to extend

About the role:

We’re hiring a Solution Design Architect to help us win and shape new business. You’ll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You’ll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren’t there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you’ll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.
 Key Responsibilities:New Business and Client Engagement Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.
Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.
Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren’t present, and know when and how to bring them in.
Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.

Requirement Gathering and Analysis Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.
Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.
Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.

Operating Model and Solution Design Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.
Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.
Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.
Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.

Commercial Modelling Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.
Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.
Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.

Stakeholder Communication Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.
Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.

Data, Measurement and Reporting Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.
Create reports and presentations that convey findings and recommendations with clarity and impact.

 About You:Essential 10-15 years’ experience in solution design, consulting, strategy, operations or a similar role within advertising, marketing, media or marketing technology.
A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).
Commercial acumen, with hands-on experience building and validating pricing or commercial models (e.g. resourcing/team-shape models, rate cards, outcome-based or performance-linked structures).
A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.
Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.
Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren’t in the room.
Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable formulating answers and options in high-pressure or contentious situations while maintaining client confidence.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insight and recommendations.
Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.

Desirable Experience contributing to new business wins, RFPs and pitch processes.
Experience in an agency, consultancy or in-house marketing transformation environment.
Experience with global or multi-market clients and remote, cross-functional teams.

 What Success Looks Like: Contribute directly to new business wins and improve pitch win rates.
Commercial models that are profitable, credible to clients and deliverable in practice.
Smooth transitions from pitch to implementation with no gap between what was sold and what is delivered.
Trusted by clients, commercial and technology teams as the go-to person for solution design.

jobs.title: Client Solutions Director / Solution Design Architect
jobs.description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER
is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.  
As a part of The Brandtech Group
, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions
enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.  
Solution Design Architect (AI / Transformation / Creative Operations)
Language requirement:
fluency in German or Spanish
Location:
Germany (primarily remote) and regular business travel across EMEA
Employment:
18-month FTC with view to extend
About the role:

We’re hiring a Solution Design Architect to help us win and shape new business. You’ll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You’ll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren’t there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you’ll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.
Key Responsibilities:New Business and Client Engagement Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.
Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.
Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren’t present, and know when and how to bring them in.
Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.

Requirement Gathering and Analysis Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.
Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.
Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.

Operating Model and Solution Design Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.
Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.
Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.
Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.

Commercial Modelling Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.
Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.
Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.

Stakeholder Communication Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.
Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.

Data, Measurement and Reporting Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.
Create reports and presentations that convey findings and recommendations with clarity and impact.

About You:Essential 10-15 years’ experience in solution design, consulting, strategy, operations or a similar role within advertising, marketing, media or marketing technology.
A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).
Commercial acumen, with hands-on experience building and validating pricing or commercial models (e.g. resourcing/team-shape models, rate cards, outcome-based or performance-linked structures).
A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.
Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.
Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren’t in the room.
Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable formulating answers and options in high-pressure or contentious situations while maintaining client confidence.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insight and recommendations.
Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.

Desirable Experience contributing to new business wins, RFPs and pitch processes.
Experience in an agency, consultancy or in-house marketing transformation environment.
Experience with global or multi-market clients and remote, cross-functional teams.

What Success Looks Like: Contribute directly to new business wins and improve pitch win rates.
Commercial models that are profitable, credible to clients and deliverable in practice.
Smooth transitions from pitch to implementation with no gap between what was sold and what is delivered.
Trusted by clients, commercial and technology teams as the go-to person for solution design.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

About us

Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from healthcare to social care. We work closely with our Finnish customers to develop our own products and services. We want to provide solutions which enable healthcare and social care professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients and customers. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

About The Role

We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join a Patient Engagement development team. Our activities are directed at supporting the citizen-oriented parts of the healthcare system manufactured by Tieto and they include analysis, design, development, testing, maintenance, and release tasks. You will have opportunities to design and develop new features, maintain existing applications, and configure them in our SaaS environments. The work is going to be performed in a hybrid mode, giving the opportunity to work either from the office or from home, according to the agreed schedule.

Who we are looking for:

You live in (or at a commuting distance to) Szczecin, Warsaw or Wroclaw.
You have a good working proficiency in English, both spoken and written.
You have at least 3 years of experience of working professionally as a Software Engineer on commercial projects.
You have a full stack developer attitude with the primary focus on backend development
You have good practical knowledge of .Net framework, .Net 8+, and SQL, especially the Microsoft SQL flavor, including the Service broker functionality. You can use the Entity Framework in C# to access and use the databases.
You are a person with confidence to take responsibility and ownership.
You have the right personality and attitude to work together in a team, learn from your peers and pass on what you’ve learned to others.
You consider the testing as a natural component of the development flow, both in terms of creating unit/integration tests as well as executing the manual tests in the test environments.
You are familiar with web services (REST, SOAP) and know how to develop, deploy, and test them using IIS as a host

Nice to have skills:

You have experience in developing software for the SaaS environments.
You have basic experience with Angular, CSS, HTML, Javascript.
You are familiar with Git and Azure DevOps

We offer

We offer you an inspiring position with great opportunities for professional growth. With us you will have the opportunity to directly influence your career development. If you have good ideas, people will listen to you. What's more, we offer you a job that suits you. At Tieto, we promote a healthy work-life balance and a friendly, caring atmosphere. We believe that trust fosters freedom and creativity. Our culture is built on transparency and active sharing – a truly open environment.

In addition to this we offer you great benefits and opportunity to work with inspiring colleagues. With us you will be working with highly skilled professionals and experience being a part of the Tieto software development network.

Did we get you inspired?

We look forward to your application! Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact Tomasz Lisowski ( tomasz.lisowski@tieto.com)

What’s in it for you?

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

We perform background checks on all final candidates.

Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto

Stay alert to recruitment scams:

Tieto only communicates via @tieto.com email addresses.
We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

jobs.description:
Job Description

About us

Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from healthcare to social care. We work closely with our Finnish customers to develop our own products and services. We want to provide solutions which enable healthcare and social care professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients and customers. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

About The Role

We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join a Patient Engagement development team. Our activities are directed at supporting the citizen-oriented parts of the healthcare system manufactured by Tieto and they include analysis, design, development, testing, maintenance, and release tasks. You will have opportunities to design and develop new features, maintain existing applications, and configure them in our SaaS environments. The work is going to be performed in a hybrid mode, giving the opportunity to work either from the office or from home, according to the agreed schedule.

Who we are looking for:

You live in (or at a commuting distance to) Szczecin, Warsaw or Wroclaw.
You have a good working proficiency in English, both spoken and written.
You have at least 3 years of experience of working professionally as a Software Engineer on commercial projects.
You have a full stack developer attitude with the primary focus on backend development
You have good practical knowledge of .Net framework, .Net 8+, and SQL, especially the Microsoft SQL flavor, including the Service broker functionality. You can use the Entity Framework in C# to access and use the databases.
You are a person with confidence to take responsibility and ownership.
You have the right personality and attitude to work together in a team, learn from your peers and pass on what you’ve learned to others.
You consider the testing as a natural component of the development flow, both in terms of creating unit/integration tests as well as executing the manual tests in the test environments.
You are familiar with web services (REST, SOAP) and know how to develop, deploy, and test them using IIS as a host

Nice to have skills:

You have experience in developing software for the SaaS environments.
You have basic experience with Angular, CSS, HTML, Javascript.
You are familiar with Git and Azure DevOps

We offer

We offer you an inspiring position with great opportunities for professional growth. With us you will have the opportunity to directly influence your career development. If you have good ideas, people will listen to you. What's more, we offer you a job that suits you. At Tieto, we promote a healthy work-life balance and a friendly, caring atmosphere. We believe that trust fosters freedom and creativity. Our culture is built on transparency and active sharing – a truly open environment.

In addition to this we offer you great benefits and opportunity to work with inspiring colleagues. With us you will be working with highly skilled professionals and experience being a part of the Tieto software development network.

Did we get you inspired?

We look forward to your application! Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact Tomasz Lisowski ( tomasz.lisowski@tieto.com)

What’s in it for you?

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

We perform background checks on all final candidates.

Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto

Stay alert to recruitment scams:

Tieto only communicates via @tieto.com email addresses.
We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.

The Director, Platform Engineering & DevOps is responsible for supporting and executing Fortrea's Platform Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, and Software Delivery strategy in alignment with established enterprise standards. This leader is accountable for managing the engineering platforms, cloud infrastructure, automation capabilities, and developer experience that enable secure, scalable, reliable, and efficient software delivery across the enterprise.

Working closely with Product Engineering, Architecture, Security, Data & AI, Infrastructure, and Technology Leadership, the Director will establish the technical foundations that accelerate engineering productivity, improve developer experience, increase deployment velocity, strengthen operational resilience, and enable engineering teams to rapidly deliver innovative, high-quality products.

This position is accountable for engineering productivity, software delivery performance, cloud engineering standards, platform reliability, operational excellence, AI-enabled engineering capabilities, and continuous modernization of Fortrea's engineering ecosystem.

HYBRID ROLE IN WARSAW

Support and execute Fortrea's Platform Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, and Software Delivery strategy aligned with business and technology objectives.
Build, lead, mentor, and develop Engineering Managers, Platform Engineers, DevOps Engineers, Site Reliability Engineers, Cloud Engineers, and technical leaders while creating strong succession plans and career development opportunities.

jobs.title: Systemutvecklare C# /.NET Azure | Tekniska verken
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla digitala tjänster i en av Sveriges mest spännande branscher? Energibranschen genomgår en omfattande förändring där digitalisering och smarta lösningar spelar en avgörande roll för framtiden. Vi söker nu dig som vill vara med och bygga nästa generations digitala kundupplevelser för energibranschen! Hos oss på Tekniska Verken får du arbeta med modern systemutveckling i Azure och samtidigt bidra till ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag.

Det här är en direktrekrytering till Tekniska verken, hanterad av Experis.

Hos oss blir du en del av något större

Vi på Division Digitalisering befinner oss i en spännande utvecklingsresa där vi bygger framtidens digitala förmågor för Tekniska verken. Som utvecklare tillhör du Digital Produktutveckling som ansvarar för utveckling av våra egna produkter och tjänster som möter våra kunder. Du utvecklar lösningar som hjälper människor att förstå sin energianvändning, hantera sina abonnemang, följa sina fakturor, beställa tjänster, få information om driftstörningar och bidra till energiomställningen. Våra system hanterar stora mängder data från mätare, energisystem, kundplattformar och IoT-lösningar, där tillgänglighet, skalbarhet och säkerhet är avgörande.

Rollbeskrivning

I rollen som Systemutvecklare blir du en viktig del av vår satsning inom digital produktutveckling. Du kommer att arbeta med utveckling och vidareutveckling av våra digitala produkter och tjänster, med särskilt fokus på moderna backendlösningar och integrationer. Här arbetar du nära produktägare, UX, frontendutvecklare, arkitekter och andra backendutvecklare i tvärfunktionella produktteam med ansvar från idé till produktion. Teamen har stor frihet inom de ramar som vår målarkitektur och gemensamma plattform ger.

Rollen i korthet:
• Utveckla och vidareutveckla lösningar med fokus på backendutveckling i C# och .NET
• Bygga och förvalta API:er, integrationer och tjänster som stödjer våra digitala produkter
• Arbeta med moderna Azure-baserade lösningar och molntjänster
• Bidra till utveckling av CI/CD-flöden, automatisering och Infrastructure as Code
• Delta i design och utveckling av nya digitala lösningar, bland annat vår kommande företagsportal

Rollen ger möjlighet att arbeta brett inom vår Azure-miljö, där vi använder tekniker och tjänster såsom Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Hubs, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps och CI/CD-flöden. Här får du bygga API:er, integrationer och händelsebaserade lösningar i en modern molnplattform där både applikationer och infrastruktur hanteras som kod. AI är en naturlig del av vår utvecklingsprocess. Vi använder AI-assistenter och agenter för att öka produktiviteten, förbättra kvaliteten och automatisera repetitiva uppgifter, samtidigt som vi ställer höga krav på säkerhet, integritet och kontroll.

Din profil och bakgrund

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för systemutveckling och som drivs av att skapa lösningar som ger verkligt värde. Du är nyfiken och öppen, både när det kommer till ny teknik, nya idéer och i samarbetet med andra människor. Vi ser också att du är ansvarstagande, har ett gott självledarskap och trivs i en miljö där du får ta egna initiativ och driva ditt arbete framåt. Vi värdesätter en pragmatisk inställning och förmågan att bidra till ett positivt och prestigelöst teamklimat.

Vi söker dig som:
• Har relevant eftergymnasial utbildning eller har tillägnat dig motsvarande kunskaper genom arbetslivserfarenhet
• Har erfarenhet av backendutveckling i C# / .NET i en agil utvecklingsmiljö och trivs med molnbaserade lösningar
• Tycker om att bygga robusta API:er och tjänster och ser värdet av testning, automatisering och DevOps
• Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

Meriterande för rollen är arbetslivserfarenhet inom någon eller flera av Azure-plattformens tjänster. Vi ser även positivt på erfarenhet av distribuerade system, integrationslösningar, eventdriven arkitektur, IoT, tidsseriedata eller energibranschen. Oavsett om du är i början av din karriär eller har flera års erfarenhet är det viktigaste för oss din nyfikenhet, motivation och vilja att sätta dig in i vår verksamhet och utvecklas tillsammans med oss!

Vårt erbjudande till dig

Hos oss blir du en del av en organisation med ett tydligt samhällsuppdrag, där digitalisering och teknik spelar en avgörande roll för att skapa hållbara och samhällsviktiga digitala tjänster. Du är med och hjälper människor att använda energi smartare vilket spelar en viktig roll i den pågående energiomställningen.

Här får du:
• Arbeta med moderna tekniker och plattformar i en Azure-miljö där vi kontinuerligt utvecklar våra arbetssätt och lösningar
• Utvecklas tillsammans med positiva och engagerade kollegor i en miljö som präglas av samarbete, kunskapsdelning och starkt teknikintresse
• Bygga specialistkompetens inom en bransch i förändring, där digitalisering är en viktig möjliggörare för framtidens energisystem

Låter det här intressant?

I den här rekryteringen samarbetar vi med Experis. Vid frågor är du välkommen att ta kontakt med våra rekryteringskonsulter Jenny Lilja på jenny.lilja@se.experis.com eller Anki Snis på anki.snis@se.experis.com.
Vi arbetar med löpande urval och rekommenderar dig därför att visa ditt intresse så snart som möjligt. Sista ansökningsdag är 28/10. Tjänsten är placerad på Tekniska verkens huvudkontor i Linköping.

Vi ser fram emot att veta mer om dig!

Tekniska verken

Tekniska verken är en samhällsbärande aktör som varje dag möjliggör ett fungerande och hållbart liv för invånarna i regionen. Genom att säkra allt från energi och vatten till återvinning och digital infrastruktur skapar vi trygghet, livskvalitet och samhällsviktiga tjänster till hundratusentals invånare och företag i regionen – varje dag. Vår verksamhet märks kanske mest när den inte fungerar, men vårt värde finns i varje hem, varje arbetsplats och varje del av samhället. Läs mer om oss här: https://www.tekniskaverken.se/om-oss/

Description

Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation). We work with space technology, launch services and systems used by customers around the world.

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.

SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.

Do you want to work with software used in rocket and balloon operations? Are you comfortable with technical systems, troubleshooting and close cooperation with operations and IT?

We are looking for a Software Engineer for our Rockets and Balloons department at Esrange Space Center. The role is practical, technical and closely connected to our launch operations.

As Software Engineer, you will develop, maintain and improve software and operational systems used before, during and after rocket and balloon campaigns.

Requirements

We believe you have solid software development experience, work in a structured way and can cooperate with different technical functions.

Additional desired skills include Swedish language skills, experience with C, C++, .NET, C# or Rust, agile methods, test automation, project coordination, a university degree at bachelor level or higher, and leadership experience.

Fluency in English.
Software development and system administration skills.
Experience from Linux and Windows environments.
Deep experience in at least one programming language.
Ability to work in multidisciplinary technical environments.
Structured problem-solving skills and strong communication skills.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will work with software and systems that support safe and efficient rocket and balloon operations.

Design, develop, maintain and improve software systems used for launch operations, mission support and campaign execution.
Manage software configurations, releases, documentation and lifecycle activities.
Support troubleshooting, testing, verification and validation of operational software and related systems.
Participate in procurement, development and implementation projects involving software, automation and operational systems.
Ensure software solutions comply with applicable security, safety and quality requirements.
Collaborate closely with IT and other technical teams across SSC Space.

Benefits

We offer you

A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.

Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.

This is a full-time, permanent position based at Esrange Space Center in Kiruna.
