jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Inriver is the AI-powered Product Information Management (PIM) platform that helps brands, manufacturers, and retailers turn product data into a growth engine. Inriver connects seamlessly to upstream systems and downstream channels, enabling continuous optimization of product experiences across every touchpoint, and is trusted by more than 1,600 global brands. Our customers — from B2B manufacturers to global retailers — rely on Inriver to manage massive, complex product catalogs and get them to market faster, with less manual rework.

About the role:

We are now looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
to join our team in Malmo to lead technical engagements with our most strategic and complex customers. This is a role for someone who can walk into ambiguous, high-pressure enterprise environments and design the right solution — not just execute someone else's plan. This is a new role within our Engineering team, and we’re looking to hire two Senior Forward Deployed Engineers in Malmö and two in the US.

What you’ll do 💭

Own the technical architecture and delivery strategy for our largest and most complex customer engagements, from discovery through go-live and expansion
Act as the senior technical advisor to customer engineering and IT leadership — often CTOs, VPs of Digital, or Heads of Data — on how Inriver fits into their broader systems landscape
Design and build complex, high-leverage integrations and workflows on top of Inriver's platform, connecting it to ERP/PLM systems (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics), DAM, and downstream commerce/syndication channels
Model elastic, enterprise-scale product data structures (categories, attributes, relationships, localization) for customers with significant catalogue complexity or regulatory requirements
Lead rapid prototyping efforts to de-risk onboarding, migrations, and pilots for customers with the highest data volume or complexity
Write production-quality code - platform enhancements, connectors, extensions, internal tools — while also knowing when to bring in additional engineering support and how to scope that work
Mentor and technically guide other Forward Deployed Engineers, reviewing their solution designs and unblocking them on hard problems
Serve as a senior technical voice of the customer internally, shaping product and platform roadmap decisions based on patterns across strategic accounts
Own escalated production issues, leading real-time debugging efforts alongside customer engineering teams
Travel to customer sites as needed (expect :20–40% travel depending on account load)

What you’ll bring

We don’t expect you to tick every box - but we think you’ll succeed here if you have many of the below:

✔️7+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, or a related technical/customer-facing role, including experience owning complex technical engagements

✔️Strong hands-on coding skills in C#, with the judgment to know when to build vs. when to advise

✔️Extensive experience with REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, and enterprise integration patterns (ETL, middleware, iPaaS) at scale

✔️Track record of leading technical relationships with enterprise customers — comfortable being the senior voice in the room with customer executives

✔️Strong ability to reason about complex data models — attributes, taxonomies, relationships — and how they map to messy, real-world enterprise catalogues

✔️Experience mentoring or technically leading other engineers, even without formal management responsibility

✔️A bias toward action balanced with the judgment to architect for scale and maintainability, not just the immediate fix

✔️Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to translate fluidly between deep technical detail and executive-level strategy

✔️Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and modern deployment practices at enterprise scale

✔️High comfort with ambiguity and the ability to bring structure to messy, high-stakes customer environments

Nice to have:

Prior experience with a PIM, MDM, DAM, or product data platform
Deep experience integrating with ERP or PLM systems
Experience with ecommerce/marketplace syndication at scale
Familiarity with compliance-heavy product domains
Prior experience in a senior forward-deployed, solutions architecture, or professional services leadership role at an enterprise SaaS company
Experience contributing to pre-sales or solutioning for large enterprise deals

Why Inriver 💙

At Inriver, you’ll join a global company with a product at the centre - and people who genuinely care about building something meaningful together. For this role you will also have ownership of the most technically and strategically important customer relationships in the company, direct line of influence into product and platform roadmap decisions and a seat at the table with both customer executives and product leadership.

In our Malmö office, you’ll find things like:

Tuesday Fika☕
Friday breakfasts to start the day together
A running club and social activities for anyone who wants to join
A welcoming mix of focused work, collaboration, and a few laughs along the way

We work in a hybrid setup, with flexibility and trust as a baseline.

Ready to apply? 📬

We’d love to hear from you. If you’re curious but not 100% sure, we still encourage you to apply. We’re happy to explore the fit together!

Inriver is a global leader in Product Information Management (PIM), helping more than 1,600 brands create outstanding product experiences. Behind our success is a team of talented, collaborative, and passionate people who enjoy solving complex challenges and making an impact for customers around the world.

Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden, we have colleagues across multiple locations globally, bringing together diverse perspectives, expertise, and experiences. For more information, visit www.inriver.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Gothenburg or Lidköping; Hybrid

Airon.ai — next-generation AI infrastructure

Be part of building the systems that power the next generation of AI.

Why Airon, why now

Every wave of AI capability rests on the infrastructure beneath it. Airon is building that foundational layer — the compute and capacity that the world's most demanding AI workloads run on.

We are growing fast, working with sophisticated international enterprise customers and building the infrastructure required to support increasingly large and demanding AI workloads. This creates engineering challenges that are complex and evolving in real time.

This is a rare window to join. The market is being defined as we build, the technical decisions matter, and the engineers who join us now will have a real opportunity to shape our technology, architecture and engineering culture from the ground up.

Who we are

A tight-knit, high-energy team where people care about what they build, help each other out and have fun along the way.

We build, own and operate our own AI factories in Lidköping, Sweden, running on 100% renewable power, and sell dedicated bare-metal NVIDIA GPU compute to enterprise customers. Everything from the building to the platform is ours, which is why the engineering here is unusually broad.

The role

As AI Solutions Architect, you will be the technical authority in the room when we win strategic customers — and the person who makes sure what we sold is what we can actually deliver.

You will work hands-on with customer AI workloads, our compute platform and the designs that connect the two, taking ownership from first technical conversation through evaluation, proof of concept and onboarding. You will not simply execute against predefined specifications; you will help identify the right problems to solve and influence what we build.

You will work closely with our sales team, our platform and operations teams and our customers' engineers.

What you'll do

Own solutions end-to-end — from architecture and implementation to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
Contribute to technical decisions and help shape our architecture, engineering principles and ways of working.
Improve the reliability, performance and scalability of our technology as the business grows.
Use AI and modern engineering tools to increase development speed, quality and operational efficiency.
Work alongside our sales team on strategic customers as the technical authority in the room.
Translate customer AI workloads — training, fine-tuning, inference — into concrete compute, network and storage designs on our platform.
Run technical evaluations, benchmarks and proofs of concept, and be honest about fit.
Turn recurring customer requirements into product and roadmap input for our engineering team.
Support onboarding of new customers together with operations, so what was promised is what gets delivered.

We believe you

Have worked hands-on with AI, ML or HPC workloads and understand what they actually need from infrastructure.
Can hold a technical conversation with a customer's engineers and a commercial one with their leadership, in the same meeting.
Have experience from a solutions architect, pre-sales, technical account or platform role facing external customers.
Write and present clearly in English and enjoy being the bridge between customer needs and what we build.
Are comfortable taking work from problem definition to a reliable, working solution.
Can make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, scalability, reliability, security and technical complexity.
Are comfortable working hands-on in an international, fast-moving environment.
Have a genuine interest in using AI and modern engineering tools to improve how software and infrastructure are built.

Bonus points for

NVIDIA GPU platforms and the CUDA ecosystem.
Distributed training at scale, and the failure modes that come with it.
Kubernetes, Slurm or comparable scheduling environments.
Understanding the economics of cloud versus bare-metal compute.
Experience of enterprise procurement and security review processes.
Experience from AI infrastructure, cloud infrastructure, data centers, distributed systems, high-performance computing or another relevant technical environment.
Experience working in an early-stage, high-growth or rapidly changing company.
Experience building systems that support enterprise customers or business-critical workloads.

Who you are

Curious and technically ambitious, with a genuine interest in understanding how things work.
Low-ego and action-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership.
Analytical and pragmatic, with the ability to turn complex problems into working solutions.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity.
Collaborative and direct, with the ability to communicate technical decisions clearly.
Motivated by solving difficult problems and building technology that matters.

What's in it for you

A chance to build the foundational infrastructure behind the next generation of AI — while the market and the technology are still taking shape.

You will work on complex, real-world engineering challenges with significant room to influence architecture, technical direction and how Airon builds. You will join early enough to make a visible impact, take meaningful ownership and help shape the engineering culture as the company scales.

If you have been looking for an engineering role where the problems are genuinely difficult, the pace is high and what you build has a direct impact — this is it.

Practical

Location: Gothenburg preferred; Lidköping or hybrid possible. Travel to customers expected.
We ask all candidates to consent to a background check before starting with us.

About Your Application

Send your application to career@airon.ai. Tell us a little about yourself, what you are great at and what you would like to build with us.

We know that great candidates do not always match every requirement on paper. If this opportunity excites you and you believe you could make an impact at Airon, we would still like to hear from you.

Ready to join us?

Help us build the infrastructure that powers the next generation of AI.

Front-end erfarenhet inom följande: Angular, Vue.js eller Jquery

As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.

Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

You’ll own automated quality across the Risk & AI Vertical. This is a hands-on, code-writing role: you’ll build and maintain the test automation that keeps our risk modeling, custom data & risk feeds, and interactive visualization products reliable release after release.

You’ll write C# automation to test APIs, services and data pipelines behind risk modeling and the data & risk feeds, and use Playwright to automate the interactive risk-modeling and visualization interfaces across web (and mobile). Languages: C# (.NET); TypeScript / JavaScript where useful for Playwright
CI/CD: GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions; automated test pipelines
Under Test: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, NoSQL; Kafka / ActiveMQ; AI risk models & data feeds; React visualization UIs

Tooling: GitHub, Visual Studio Code, Visual Studio / Rider
AI Tools: GitHub Copilot, MS Copilot, Anthropic Claude (incl. Claude Code), ChatGPT; AI-assisted test generation and development

Design, write and maintain automated tests in C# across APIs, services and data pipelines for risk modelling and the custom data & risk feeds.

Create and own test frameworks, reusable libraries and test data, and integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines so they run automatically on every change.
Validate data quality, entitlement / permissioning and personalization across the vertical’s products.
Use AI tooling to accelerate test creation, coverage analysis and maintenance.

Participate in code reviews, design sessions and agile ceremonies.

Solid test automation experience with strong C# coding skills — this is a hands-on role that writes real code, not just scripts.
Hands-on experience with Playwright (or comparable modern UI / E2E frameworks such as Cypress or Selenium) for web automation.

Comfortable writing clean, maintainable code and building and owning test frameworks.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a sharp eye for edge cases.
Strong collaboration and communication skills; fluent in English (spoken and written).

Experience testing data pipelines, real-time / streaming data, or charting / visualization UIs.
Experience with performance / load testing (e.g. NBomber, k6) and observability (e.g. Grafana).
Mobile test automation experience.
Experience with BDD or contract testing (SpecFlow / Reqnroll, Pact).

jobs.title: Software Engineer 3
jobs.description:
The MongoDB Customer Observability Team is a diverse group of contributors working together to help our users manage MongoDB at global scale. The team is responsible for MongoDB Atlas: our database-as-a-service offering and fastest-growing product, which allows users to deploy globally distributed MongoDB clusters in just minutes.

We're seeking an SE3 to join our team to tackle exciting challenges within the Observability space.

You'll contribute to developing tools and platforms that help our users understand the health and performance of their MongoDB deployments. This includes collecting metrics, monitoring slow queries, and offering actionable insights such as index and schema suggestions that improve the speed, efficiency, and overall reliability of their databases.

This role provides a unique opportunity to drive engineering excellence across both dimensions of observability, leveraging technologies being developed within the Customer Observability group and contributing directly to the success of our customers and our product teams. If you're passionate about large-scale systems, digging deep into telemetry data, and building tools that make a real impact both internally and externally, we’d love to have you on board!

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

We're looking for someone who

Enjoys collaboration and being part of a team
Is approachable, curious, and intellectually honest
Is a backend engineer with a willingness to take on frontend tasks or a full-stack developer with a bias towards backend
Has written backend systems in a compiled language (Java, C#, Go, etc.)
Has experience with the design and architecture of a modern, scalable web application
Is familiar with debugging and troubleshooting production issues
Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures and their time and space complexity

Nice to Haves

Experience developing and writing code observability tools
Previous work in TypeScript, React, and Node.js, particularly maintaining an ecosystem of dependencies
Knowledge and interest of database internals and tuning mechanisms, particularly indexing

Role Responsibilities

Design, write and maintain Customer Observability code and features
Contribute to and lead medium sized technical projects into production
Work with customers and support engineers to fix issues and become part of our on-call rotation
Collaborate with a diverse group of engineers to continually improve our coding best practices and operational systems
Contribute in technical discussions and work with engineers to solve technical challenges

Success Measures

In 1 month, you'll be familiar with the parts of the system that your team owns, the existing features, and projects within the Observability team and have contributed minor tasks within our codebase
In 3 months, you will be contributing to design and development of your team’s projects and starting to ship tickets regularly
In 6 months, you will have ramped up enough to take on small+ sized projects, contribute actively in our technical discussions and proactively improve our codebase and products. You will be supporting our customers during escalations and have joined our on-call rotation

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the database for the AI era, enabling innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified database platform—the most widely available, globally distributed database on the market—helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and nearly 60,000 customers—including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups—relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. Support change control activities, validation documentation review and approval, and cross-functional project groups.

5–10 years’ experience in MES/automation systems validation, new product introduction, and/or manufacturing support within a pharmaceutical or GMP-regulated environment.

Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and solution design skills.

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
AI Architect role.

We're looking for a hands-on architect who understands what it takes to bring AI into a company successfully, safely, at scale and at speed. In short: you help us move fast without breaking things. You own the build-and-validate phase; a separate team takes proven PoCs to production. Ideal for a solutions architect who's as comfortable coding a prototype as shaping architecture decisions and bringing stakeholders along.

What you'll do:

Build PoCs with the team, then take the proven ones to production or write the spec for the team that will run them.
Solve real problems, finding the pain points, design the fix, ship it and prove the value.
Design for scale where every PoC fits our wider IT landscape and Enterprise Architecture.
Own the architecture that lets AutoStore build AI solutions safely across the company.
Work with the IT teams already building our foundations (data, integration, security, authentication and hosting). You define what AI needs from them and build on top of what they deliver.
Bring people along by explaining choices and trade-offs in plain language, to developers and business leaders alike.

Who you are:

An experienced builder with full-stack developer background.
As comfortable writing code for a prototype as you are making architecture decisions.
You know how data, integration, security and hosting fit together in a large organization.
Nice to have: experience with Azure, Databricks, or taking AI solutions into production.

You'll join a small, empowered team with one task: figure out how to get the most out of AI in what we think is Norway's coolest tech company. (TIME named our robots one of the Best Inventions of 2025, so we're not the only ones who think so.)

AutoStore already builds AI into its products. Now we want to put it to work across the whole company. There is no finished map for this, so we will make the path by walking it. We prototype fast, work closely with the business, and build together with the rest of our exceptional IT team. You'll sit close to the people who do the work, find where AI makes the biggest difference, and build the solutions that prove it. We measure success in business value, not in slides.

How We Work

Think big, start small, move fast. An idea should become a working prototype in weeks, not months.
Build, test, kill, build again. We kill our darlings early, so the best ideas get our time.
Built to grow. We build on our Azure Databricks data platform and follow our IT and enterprise architecture, so what works can scale.
Proven ideas move on. When a prototype proves its value, we take it to production or hand it over to the team that will run it. Then we pick the next problem.
Share what we learn. What we learn at the bleeding edge, we share with the rest of AutoStore as we scale up.

Location: Oslo, Stavanger, or Nedre Vats.

We Offer:

A Collaborative and Inclusive Culture where we celebrate and value everyone’s contributions, encouraging diverse perspectives in decision-making.
Work-Life Balance & Well-being: We offer 1 hour per week of paid exercise, health insurance, and a generous pension plan, prioritizing your mental and physical well-being.
A Creative and Safe Workplace by joining a company experiencing rapid growth, with the stability of being Norway’s first unicorn listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.
International and Supportive Environment within a Norwegian multinational that values collaboration and innovation.

Application deadline: October 11th
. Please note that we review applications continuously—if this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply as early as possible! All inquiries are treated confidentially.

If you are applying from outside of Norway please indicate that you will be relocating to be considered.

AutoStore does not accept agency resumes or assistance for this role. Please do not forward resumes to our job's alias or AutoStore employees. AutoStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. This policy should be respected.

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
AI Architect role.

We're looking for a hands-on architect who understands what it takes to bring AI into a company successfully, safely, at scale and at speed. In short: you help us move fast without breaking things. You own the build-and-validate phase; a separate team takes proven PoCs to production. Ideal for a solutions architect who's as comfortable coding a prototype as shaping architecture decisions and bringing stakeholders along.

What you'll do:

Build PoCs with the team, then take the proven ones to production or write the spec for the team that will run them.
Solve real problems, finding the pain points, design the fix, ship it and prove the value.
Design for scale where every PoC fits our wider IT landscape and Enterprise Architecture.
Own the architecture that lets AutoStore build AI solutions safely across the company.
Work with the IT teams already building our foundations (data, integration, security, authentication and hosting). You define what AI needs from them and build on top of what they deliver.
Bring people along by explaining choices and trade-offs in plain language, to developers and business leaders alike.

Who you are:

An experienced builder with full-stack developer background.
As comfortable writing code for a prototype as you are making architecture decisions.
You know how data, integration, security and hosting fit together in a large organization.
Nice to have: experience with Azure, Databricks, or taking AI solutions into production.

You'll join a small, empowered team with one task: figure out how to get the most out of AI in what we think is Norway's coolest tech company. (TIME named our robots one of the Best Inventions of 2025, so we're not the only ones who think so.)

AutoStore already builds AI into its products. Now we want to put it to work across the whole company. There is no finished map for this, so we will make the path by walking it. We prototype fast, work closely with the business, and build together with the rest of our exceptional IT team. You'll sit close to the people who do the work, find where AI makes the biggest difference, and build the solutions that prove it. We measure success in business value, not in slides.

How We Work

Think big, start small, move fast. An idea should become a working prototype in weeks, not months.
Build, test, kill, build again. We kill our darlings early, so the best ideas get our time.
Built to grow. We build on our Azure Databricks data platform and follow our IT and enterprise architecture, so what works can scale.
Proven ideas move on. When a prototype proves its value, we take it to production or hand it over to the team that will run it. Then we pick the next problem.
Share what we learn. What we learn at the bleeding edge, we share with the rest of AutoStore as we scale up.

Location: Oslo, Stavanger, or Nedre Vats.

We Offer:

A Collaborative and Inclusive Culture where we celebrate and value everyone’s contributions, encouraging diverse perspectives in decision-making.
Work-Life Balance & Well-being: We offer 1 hour per week of paid exercise, health insurance, and a generous pension plan, prioritizing your mental and physical well-being.
A Creative and Safe Workplace by joining a company experiencing rapid growth, with the stability of being Norway’s first unicorn listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.
International and Supportive Environment within a Norwegian multinational that values collaboration and innovation.

jobs.title: Azure Integration Architect / Presales Architect
jobs.description:
Innostutko asiakkaiden liiketoimintahaasteiden ratkaisemisesta moderneilla integraatio- ja pilvipalveluratkaisuilla? Viihdytkö liiketoiminnan, arkkitehtuurin ja asiakastyön rajapinnassa?

Sijainti: Suomi
Kokemustaso: Mid/Senior

Etsimme kokenutta Azure-integraatioarkkitehtia vahvistamaan Solitan integraatioliiketoimintaa Suomessa.

Roolin kuvaus

Tässä roolissa toimit asiakkaidemme luotettuna neuvonantajana ja osallistut integraatio- ja pilviratkaisujen suunnitteluun aina ensimmäisistä asiakaskeskusteluista toteutukseen asti.
Työssä korostuvat asiakkaiden kanssa työskentely sekä myynnin tukeminen. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, myynnin ja teknisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa ymmärtääksesi asiakkaan liiketoimintahaasteet ja muuntaaksesi ne toimiviksi, skaalautuviksi ja turvallisiksi Azure-pohjaisiksi ratkaisuiksi. Pystyt keskustelemaan sujuvasti liiketoimintajohdon kanssa asiakkaan tavoitteista ja haasteista sekä syventymään teknisiin ratkaisuihin arkkitehtien ja kehittäjien kanssa.

Integraatioarkkitehtina mahdollistat älykkään, turvallisen ja liiketoimintaa tukevan järjestelmien yhteentoimivuuden. Suunnittelet ja toteutat integraatioratkaisuja, joiden avulla data ja prosessit liikkuvat saumattomasti organisaation sisällä ja ekosysteemien välillä. Roolissasi yhdistyvät pitkäjänteinen arkkitehtuurityö, toimitusten sparraus sekä AI-avusteisten toimintamallien hyödyntäminen integraatioiden suunnittelussa, toteutuksessa, laadunvarmistuksessa ja dokumentoinnissa.

Johdat teknistä visiota siitä, kuinka järjestelmät kommunikoivat skaalautuvasti, hallitusti ja turvallisesti. Valitset sopivat integraatiomallit, teknologiat ja toimintatavat, määrittelet arkkitehtuuriperiaatteet ja varmistat, että ratkaisut tukevat sekä nykyisiä liiketoimintatarpeita että pidemmän aikavälin IT-strategiaa. Samalla huolehdit siitä, että integraatioiden operoitavuus, laatu, dokumentaatio ja hallintamallit ovat kestävällä pohjalla.

Keskitymme moderneihin API-ratkaisuihin, pilvipohjaisiin integraatioihin ja automaatioon valiten aina asiakkaalle parhaiten sopivat työkalut. Laatu ja parhaat käytännöt ohjaavat kaikkea tekemistämme, ja hyödynnämme aktiivisesti tekoälyä kehitystyön tehostamiseksi ja entistä parempien ratkaisujen tuottamiseksi.

Keskeisiä integraatioteknologioitamme ovat Azure, MuleSoft, Apache Camel. Työskentelemme myös Workaton ja Kafkan parissa. Meillä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisissa projekteissa sekä julkisella että yksityisellä sektorilla.

Kokemuksestasi ja vastuutasostasi riippuen kuukausipalkka tässä roolissa on 5 200–6 200 euroa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Vahva kokemus integraatioarkkitehtuurista ja yritystason integraatioratkaisuista
Kokemusta Microsoft Azure -ympäristöjen suunnittelusta ja hyödyntämisestä
Kykyä toimia sekä liiketoiminnan että teknisten sidosryhmien kanssa
Kokemusta työpajojen, vaatimusmäärittelyjen ja asiakaskeskustelujen fasilitoinnista
Ymmärrystä tekoälyn ja AI-agenttien hyödyntämisestä osana yritysarkkitehtuuria, integraatioita tai liiketoimintaprosesseja.
Erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja esiintymistaitoja suomeksi ja englanniksi
Kykyä muuntaa asiakkaan liiketoimintahaasteet konkreettisiksi teknisiksi ratkaisuiksi
Kokemusta myynnin tukemisesta ratkaisusuunnittelun, tarjousten ja asiakastapaamisten kautta
Ymmärrystä API-arkkitehtuureista, tapahtumapohjaisista ratkaisuista ja pilvinatiiveista integraatiomalleista
Konsultoivaa työotetta ja kykyä rakentaa luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita

Katsomme lisäksi eduksi

Kokemus Azure Integration Services -ratkaisuista
Kokemus API Management -alustoista
Ymmärrys data-, analytiikka- ja AI-ratkaisujen integraatiotarpeista
Kokemus laajojen arkkitehtuurikokonaisuuksien tai muutoshankkeiden johtamisesta
Microsoft Azure -sertifioinnit

Huomioithan, että useat asiakasprojektimme edellyttävät sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

Millainen henkilö menestyy tässä roolissa?

Viihdyt asiakkaiden kanssa ja nautit teknologian, liiketoiminnan sekä uusien mahdollisuuksien tunnistamisen yhdistämisestä.
Osaat keskustella asiakkaan johdon kanssa liiketoiminnan tavoitteista ja haasteista sekä toisaalta sparrata kehittäjiä ja arkkitehteja teknisissä ratkaisuissa. Näet arkkitehtuurin keinona luoda liiketoiminta-arvoa, et pelkästään teknisinä piirustuksina.
Olet oma-aloitteinen, kaupallisesti ajatteleva ja motivoidut asiakkaiden onnistumisesta sekä Solitan liiketoiminnan kasvattamisesta.

Miksi viihtyisit meillä?

Asiantuntijayhteisö

Osaajayhteisömme tarjoaa mahdollisuuden jatkuvaan oppimiseen ja ammatilliseen kehittymiseen. Arvostamme yhteistyötä ja vahvaa yhteisöllisyyttä projektien ja asiakkaiden välillä. Se on yksi tärkeimmistä syistä siihen, miksi ihmiset viihtyvät tiimissämme.
Vapautta ja joustavuutta

Solitalla työ mukautuu elämääsi, ei päinvastoin. Voit työskennellä mistä päin Suomea tahansa ja meillä on joustava etätyöpolitiikka, asiakastarve huomioiden.
Kattavat edut

Voit valita omat työvälineesi, hyödyntää laajaa työterveyshuoltoa, käyttää hierontaetua, pyöräetua, saada tukea sisäisiltä valmentajiltamme sekä osallistua erilaisiin harrastuskerhoihimme.
Kiinteä kuukausipalkka

Kannustamme oppimiseen, osaamisen kehittämiseen, yhteistyöhön ja tiedon jakamiseen ilman laskutusasteeseen perustuvaa palkitsemismallia.
Mahdollisuuksia kasvaa

Solita Growth Academy, mentorointi ja mahdollisuus siirtyä erilaisiin projekteihin tarjoavat jatkuvia mahdollisuuksia ammatilliseen kehittymiseen.
Vaikuttavia asiakasprojekteja

Olemme esimerkiksi auttaneet metsäkonevalmistaja Ponssea tehostamaan toimintaansa ja kasvattamaan palveluliiketoimintaansa toimittamalla modernin pilvipohjaisen data-alustan sekä integraatiot useisiin tietolähteisiin.

Haluatko liittyä Solitan integraatioyhteisöön?

Jos tämä kuulostaa sinulle sopivalta mahdollisuudelta, lähetä meille CV:si, LinkedIn-profiilisi tai hakemuksesi. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Saila Karonen (saila.karonen@solita.fi).

Keskeisenä teknologia-, data- ja designkumppanina Solitan liiketoiminta perustuu luottamukseen ja vastuullisuuteen. Tästä syystä valitun hakijan henkilöllisyys ja työhistoria tarkistetaan. Nämä tarkastukset suoritetaan työelämän yksityisyyden suojasta annetun lain mukaisesti ja sen rajoissa.
Tässä tehtävässä työskentely voi edellyttää asiakkaamme pyynnöstä tehtävää turvallisuusselvitystä. Turvallisuusselvitys toteutetaan turvallisuusselvityslain mukaisesti, ja sen hyväksytty läpäiseminen on tehtävässä työskentelyn edellytys.

jobs.title: Manager, Tax Technology — VAT (Wolt & Deliveroo Tax Platform & Business Projects)
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About The Team

We are looking for an experienced Manager, Tax Technology to lead tax platform projects for Wolt and Deliveroo within our growing Tax Team. As Wolt and Deliveroo onboard onto the global unified tax platform and a single tax calculation engine (Vertex), this role owns the functional tax leadership that turns business and VAT requirements into configured, tested, live capabilities, and leads the offshore Wolt & Deliveroo implementation team delivering that work day to day. As DoorDash continues to grow its international footprint, we are looking for a candidate with deep, hands-on experience in VAT regimes who can lead a team, collaborate cross-functionally, and own the delivery of tax features and new-platform feature / new-market / new-partnership launches across Wolt and Deliveroo.

About The Role

You will report to the Senior Manager of the Tax Calculation Platform & Mx Operations and lead tax platform and business projects for Wolt and Deliveroo. You will manage a team to deliver day-to-day VAT configuration and testing, and partner closely with Tax Engineering, the Wolt and Deliveroo Tax teams, Tax Product, and other stakeholders — gathering business and VAT requirements, translating them into tax-system functional requirements for configuration and testing, and reviewing Technical Design Documents (TDDs) to provide functional tax expertise back to Tax Engineering.

The primary focus of this position is end-to-end delivery of VAT tax solutions across the Wolt and Deliveroo platforms — new product, market, partnership launches and legislative changes, roadmap alignment with Wolt and Deliveroo's international expansion, and day-to-day leadership of the team executing that delivery — with an understanding of how data flows from upstream systems through the tax engine to downstream reporting. Rather than handing off requirements to the Vertex Center of Excellence team, you will apply your own Vertex knowledge to help influence the functional design and determine the specific Vertex configuration a solution requires. Familiarity with US sales and use tax, food and beverage, and retail tax context is valuable for alignment with the broader platform.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

Lead tax platform and business projects across the Wolt and Deliveroo platforms, including new product, market, partnership launches, and legislative changes.
Gather business and VAT requirements and translate them into tax-system functional requirements for configuration, testing and delivery.
Review BRDs, PRDs, and TDDs for VAT tax-system implications and provide functional tax expertise back to Tax Engineering.
Define testing requirements and oversee validations across unit, integration, E2E, shadow, and post-launch phases.
Align tax engine priorities and the integrated delivery plan with the Wolt and Deliveroo international market roadmaps, and represent tax platform status updates to Tax and Engineering leadership.
Trace VAT-relevant data from upstream systems through Vertex to downstream reporting and compliance.
Serve as the senior functional tax leader for Wolt and Deliveroo, escalating risk and driving cross-functional alignment across Tax, Product, Engineering, and Data.
Manage and develop a team supporting this area, allocating workload, establishing QA checkpoints, and providing structured knowledge transfer on complex processes.

We’re excited about you because…

You have 8+ years of indirect tax or indirect tax technology experience, with several years working directly in VAT regimes.
You are familiar with VAT tax requirements and can translate them into system requirements.
Hands-on experience implementing or configuring Vertex O Series, and ability to review Vertex configurations and testing documentation and provide feedback.
Hand-on experience implementing or configuring ERP tax integration (e.g. Netsuite) with Vertex tax engine.
Experience with multi-country VAT implementations and EU VAT compliance; familiarity with non-US indirect tax regimes more broadly is a plus.
Demonstrated people-leadership experience, including managing, coaching, workload delegation, and quality oversight.
You can review technical design documents and provide functional tax expertise to engineering and product.
You have familiarity with US sales and use tax, food and beverage, and retail tax context.
You understand how tax data flows from upstream transaction systems through a tax engine to downstream reporting, including both in-house systems or ERP system integration flows.
Program or project management experience across dependent teams, including building plans, milestones, and dependency maps, and driving them to completion.
Comfort operating cross-functionally and building trust with partner teams without always holding formal authority over their roadmaps.
Experience in use of SQL or Snowflake for data self-serve, issue investigation or testing validation.
Experience in use of API testing tools like Postman, SOAP UI and ability to read XML and JSON logs.
Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, or Computer Science degree.
You are fluent in leveraging multiple AI tools on the market (e.g., Claude Cowork, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor) on a daily basis across all of your assigned tasks, and you actively look for creative ways to apply them to enhance processes and create efficiency gains.

Nice to Haves

Familiarity with Marketplace Facilitator laws.
Experience managing offshore teams across time zones.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

jobs.description:
Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help us shape the next generation of development at Dalux.

You will work on products used by professionals around the world, contribute to architectural and technical decisions, and have the opportunity to influence not only what we build, but also how we build it.

Increasingly, this means thinking about how we use AI to make software development more effective.

Your role

As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will work as part of a product team together with other developers, a Product Manager, and a Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks: helping make good technical decisions, improving the codebase and architecture, sharing knowledge, and raising the engineering standard around them.

Depending on your experience and interests, your work can include:

Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end
Designing and implementing scalable, maintainable solutions
Contributing to architectural decisions and technical direction
Identifying and addressing technical debt where it creates meaningful value
Improving engineering practices, tools, and developer workflows
Driving or contributing to initiatives around infrastructure as code, DevOps, CI/CD, architecture, or developer tooling
Sparring with and mentoring other developers
Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions
Bringing new ideas and technologies into Dalux when they can improve our products or development practices

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

AI-assisted software development

We are significantly increasing our focus on AI-assisted development across Dalux.

We are actively exploring how AI can improve the software development lifecycle – from understanding requirements and exploring technical approaches to coding, testing, review, debugging, refactoring, and automation.

We do not see AI as a replacement for strong engineering fundamentals. We see it as a tool that can make capable developers more effective when combined with technical judgment and a clear understanding of the problem being solved.

As an experienced developer, we want you to take an active role in this development: experimenting with new workflows, critically evaluating their value, sharing what works, and helping us establish good engineering practices around AI-assisted development.

Practical experience using AI as part of your development workflow is an advantage. More importantly, you should be curious about how these tools are changing software engineering and willing to continue developing your own way of working.

Technologies we work with

Our platform is built on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS.

Our primary technologies include:

C# / .NET
Angular / TypeScript
GitHub CoPilot
MSSQL
Elasticsearch
AWS
Optionally, Android / iOS development using .NET MAUI

You may also encounter parts of our C++ codebase, including opportunities to modernize and improve existing solutions.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

Product development at Dalux

Our product teams bring developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers together.

Developers are expected to understand the problem being solved and contribute to finding the solution – not simply implement specifications handed to them.

As an experienced developer, you will have an important voice in balancing user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

Your background

We expect that you:

Have solid professional software development experience
Hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related technical field
Have strong software engineering fundamentals
Are comfortable owning complex technical problems and decisions
Care about maintainability, reliability, performance, and quality
Can navigate and improve an established codebase and architecture
Enjoy technical sparring and sharing knowledge with other developers
Are proactive and willing to challenge existing approaches when you see a better solution
Understand the trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term technical quality
Are interested in how AI and new development tools can improve your effectiveness as an engineer

What You Can Expect From Dalux

Dalux is a software company at heart.

Significant ownership of the software you build
Real influence on technical solutions and engineering practices
Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussion and constructive challenge
Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design
Short paths from technical ideas to decisions and implementation
Opportunities to drive improvements beyond your immediate product work
An environment actively investing in AI-assisted software development
High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems
A social workplace with monthly events and employee-driven clubs

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. Working together in person is an important part of how we collaborate, share knowledge, and make decisions quickly.

About Dalux

Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, Dalux develops user-friendly software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.

Har arbejdet praktisk med generativ AI, LLM’er eller AI-assistenter

Kommunikerer tydeligt med både udviklere, ledere og procesejere

jobs.title: Azure Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Om dit kommende job

Fellowmind Managed Platform – FMP – er vores fælles platform til standardiseret, sikker og effektiv håndtering af kundernes Azure-miljøer. Platformen kombinerer automatisering, governance og managed services i en skalerbarløsning, der løbende udvikles i takt med kundernes behov og Microsofts teknologier.

Som Azure Platform Engineer bliver du en del af hele platformens livscyklus. Du kommer både til at onboarde nye kunder, implementere løsninger og bidrage til den løbende udvikling og drift af platformen.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med kunder, konsulenter, arkitekter og resten af FMP-teamet. Du får gradvist mere indflydelse i takt med, at du lærer platformen, kunderne og vores arbejdsmetoder at kende.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

Onboarding af nye kunder og deres Azure-miljøer på FMP
Implementering og konfiguration af platformskomponenter
Automatisering af deployment, konfiguration og driftsopgaver
Udvikling og vedligeholdelse af Infrastructure as Code
Fejlsøgning og håndtering af tekniske problemstillinger
Test, dokumentation og kvalitetssikring af løsninger
Deltagelse i dialogen med kunder om behov og mulige løsninger
Bidrag til videreudvikling af FMP’s funktionalitet, værktøjer og standarder

Sådan arbejder vi

FMP-teamet arbejder efter principperne i Golazo. Vi deler arbejdet op i mindre, værdiskabende leverancer og afstemmer tilgang og design, før vi går i gang med implementeringen.

Vi betragter ikke en opgave som færdig, blot fordi teknikken virker. Test, dokumentation, monitorering og validering hos kunden er en del af leverancen.

Du behøver ikke kende Golazo på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde struktureret, gøre dit arbejde synligt og give og modtage konstruktiv feedback.

Om teamet

Du bliver en del af vores Cloud, Security & Operations-team og får din daglige gang i det tværfaglige team omkring FMP.

Teamet består af konsulenter og arkitekter med forskellige faglige styrker inden for blandt andet Azure, automatisering, sikkerhed, softwareudvikling og managed services. Vi arbejder på tværs af Fellowminds lokationer og lande oglægger stor vægt på samarbejde, fælles ejerskab og videndeling.

Du får mulighed for at lære af erfarne kolleger og samtidig sætte dit eget præg på platformen og vores måde at arbejde på.

Om dine kompetencer

Der kan være flere veje ind i rollen. Du kan eksempelvis have en baggrund som cloud- eller infrastrukturkonsulent, DevOps engineer, platform engineer eller udvikler med interesse for Azure.

Vi forestiller os at du

Har en teknisk nysgerrighed og et solidt fundament inden for cloudteknologier. Du har praktisk erfaring med Azure eller lignende cloudplatforme og har arbejdet med automatisering, scripting eller Infrastructure as Code. Samtidig har du forståelse for centrale områder som sikkerhed, governance og stabil drift, og du trives med at analysere tekniske problemstillinger og arbejde struktureret frem mod holdbare løsninger.

Du er vant til at dokumentere dit arbejde og dele viden med dine kolleger, og du kan arbejde selvstændigt inden for klare rammer. Derudover motiveres du af at kombinere produktudvikling med konkrete kundeopgaver, hvor du kan omsætte teknologi til værdi. Du kommunikerer professionelt og ubesværet på både dansk og engelsk.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med:

Azure landing zones, governance og identitetsstyring med Azure Policy, RBAC og Microsoft Entra ID
Infrastructure as Code med eksempelvis Bicep, Terraform eller tilsvarende teknologier
Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD samt automatisering med PowerShell, Azure CLI eller lignende værktøjer
Monitorering, logging og observability samt kendskab til Cloud Adoption Framework, Well-Architected Framework eller drift af cloudplatforme

Vi forventer ikke, at du allerede kan det hele. Det vigtigste er, at du har et godt teknisk fundament, er nysgerrig og har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med platformen og teamet.

Om dig

Du går op i kvalitet og tager ansvar for, at dine leverancer fungerer i praksis. Du er nysgerrig, opsøger ny viden og spørger om hjælp, når det skaber et bedre resultat.

Du trives med at arbejde i et team, hvor løsninger bliver kvalificeret gennem dialog og review. Du kan stå på egne ben, men holder ikke viden eller udfordringer for dig selv.

Samtidig har du blik for, at den bedste tekniske løsning ikke nødvendigvis er den mest avancerede. Den skal være forståelig, driftsvenlig og skabe reel værdi for kunden.

Do you feel like the tools that make a game are more interesting than the game itself?

As our new Senior Unity Tools Developer, you’ll join our Core Tech team building and maintaining the shared tools and packages that power everything we make, from hands and cars to horses and beyond.

Your focus will be on making great internal tools: creating solid, well-documented packages, improving our testing and automation setup, and jumping in when Unity issues need debugging.

Here’s what your job looks like day to day

Building and maintaining Unity tools like automation, localization, or game data (with great documentation and a strong “others will use this” mindset)
Helping debug and troubleshoot issues in Unity (editor and runtime)
Collaborating with other team members on new packages
Improving the overall game development experience for everyone through better workflows, reliability, and clarity in our shared tools

Must-haves

Proficiency in C# and a deep knowledge of Unity tooling, including its asset pipeline
Experience shipping iOS and macOS apps with hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and CloudKit, using Xcode and Swift
Experience with performance optimization
Strong fundamentals in software design (e.g. unit testing, integration testing, dependency injection, design patterns)
A deep interest in tools development: you get more excited about building tooling and setting up efficient workflows than working directly on player-facing game features
An investigative mindset: you’re curious, thorough, and enjoy getting to the bottom of tricky problems
A genuine interest in sharing knowledge: you enjoy bringing people together, explaining how things work and helping them adopt tools

Nice-to-haves

Experience with automated testing of Unity projects, including on-device testing
Experience with graphics and shaders programming
Interest in experimenting with and using AI tools (e.g. Claude Code) in your day-to-day

Requirements For Any Job At Triband

You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward.
You're motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture.
You value a positive work environment and contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place.
You have team production experiences, such as using version control software (we use git), branching, stand-ups, sprints, and reviews.

Practicalities

We don’t offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role.
We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.
We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.
No crunch. People over deadlines.
Our working language is English.

We offer

Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.
A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.
Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.
A professional development budget to invest in your growth.
Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.
Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).
Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).
Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.
Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.
Pension plan and private health insurance.
Endless amounts of coffee.

WHAT THE TRIBAND?

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 50 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

Date: 24 Sept 2026

Company: Singapore Pools (Pte) Ltd

Work that powers communities.

Who We Are

Singapore Pools was established by the Singapore government on 23 May 1968 to provide safe and trusted betting to counter illegal gambling. As a not-for-profit organisation, it makes contributions to the Tote Board to fund a wide range of causes in social service, community development, sports, arts, education and health sectors.

Since 2004, over $5 billion have been channelled to the Tote Board. In addition, Singapore Pools also contributes about $2 billion annually to the Government in the form of taxes and duties. Its responsible gaming practices have been awarded the highest level of certification (Level 4) by the World Lottery Association’s Responsible Gaming Framework since 2012.

Since inception, Singapore Pools’ staff have a long-standing commitment to doing good and giving back to those in need. Staff volunteers support activities held all year round, from helping disadvantaged children, youth-at-risk, underprivileged families, and elderly, to conserving the environment.

Job Purpose

The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) drives enterprise operational resilience by architecting scalable cloud infrastructure, managing the enterprise DevOps toolchain, and ensuring centralized system observability across hybrid cloud environments. Leveraging a strong software engineering background, the SRE implements GitOps methodologies and develops custom automation applications and API-based services. By heavily utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and GenAI tools, this role eliminates manual operations, drives efficiency, optimizes cloud expenditures, and ensures maximum system uptime against stringent SLAs.

What You'll Do

Software Engineering & Automation: Write code and develop automated, API-based applications (including GenAI integrations) to streamline operational reporting and eliminate recurring manual tasks.
Reliability & Operations: Implement SRE best practices for observability, availability, performance, and incident response. Define, measure, and govern Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Error Budgets in collaboration with product engineering teams. Participate in on-call rotations, execute postmortem/RCAs, and identify/fix production bottlenecks.
Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure: Support product teams in building fault-tolerant applications by enforcing infrastructure deployment via rigorous IaC code reviews.
CI/CD & Toolchain: Maintain DevOps systems and enforce GitOps workflows and integrate automated security/vulnerability scanning into CI/CD pipelines for all application, container, and IaC deployment approvals.
Observability: Create and maintain consolidated operations dashboards by integrating telemetry from disparate monitoring tools and native AWS/Azure metrics.
FinOps: Generate actionable FinOps reporting to track and optimize hybrid cloud spending.
Resilience & Documentation: Execute disaster recovery (DR), backup, redundancy, and capacity planning strategies while maintaining high-quality runbooks and operational documentation.

Who You Are

Degree-qualified in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Science or related IT Discipline, with 4 to 7 years of proven, hands-on experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, DevOps, or SRE roles.
Hold professional certifications such as ITIL, FinOps Certified Practitioner, AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional), AWS Certified DevOps Engineer (Professional), AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer (Associate), Microsoft Certified Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400).
Cloud Architecture & Engineering: Deep hands-on experience building scalable hybrid cloud infrastructures (AWS and Azure) and containerization. Strong understanding of modern hosting, networking design patterns, and applying the Six Pillars of operational excellence across environments.
Software Engineering: Strong background building production-level software in Python, Golang, or Java. Experience developing and deploying API-based services and serverless applications on AWS Lambda and Azure Functions.
Automation & Infrastructure as Code (IaC): High proficiency in IaC and configuration management tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation) and container orchestration systems (e.g., Kubernetes). Proven capability in enforcing deployment pipelines through rigorous code review processes and working within Agile methodologies.
Version Control: Proficient in Git, including advanced branching strategies and GitOps paradigms.
Systems Knowledge: Deep expertise in architecting and managing centralized Observability platforms, utilizing GenAI, time-series databases, and diverse monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, Splunk, InfluxDB) to trace distributed cloud applications. Solid understanding of Database Administration and Networking architecture.
Professional & Interpersonal Skills: Ability to make sound, logical, data-based decisions on complex issues while considering risks. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Strong interest in technological trends and disruptions impacting Cloud Engineering and SRE.

Health & wellness benefits
Continuous learning and upskilling opportunities
Volunteerism and community initiatives

jobs.title: Software Architect (Backend-focused)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Software Architect
to lead the design and evolution of various backend systems for our clients' platforms. This is a client-facing technical leadership role where you will work across multiple projects and stakeholders, translating client requirements into technical solutions that hold up in production.

While the primary focus is backend architecture, the role also requires good working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and security, since backend design decisions now shape deployment and security choices too. Frontend is not part of the core responsibilities, but familiarity with how backend design decisions affect frontend integration is expected. Increasingly, client projects call for backend systems that incorporate AI/LLM-powered features (chat interfaces, retrieval-augmented generation, copilots, automation). You will be expected to architect these components with the same rigor as any other backend service, covering data pipelines, APIs, security, and scalability, rather than treating them as a separate discipline.

Responsibilities

Design and own end-to-end backend architecture (APIs, services, data models, and integration patterns) for client projects of varying scale and complexity
Define and evolve architectural patterns (microservices, modular monoliths, event-driven architecture, API-first design) appropriate to each client's context and constraints
Translate business and functional requirements from clients into technical designs, estimates, and delivery plans
Design cloud-native and containerized solutions (Kubernetes, Docker) across major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), including hybrid and multi-cloud scenarios where relevant
Build security into the architecture from day one: authentication/authorization (OAuth2/OIDC), secrets and identity management, data protection, and alignment with standards such as OWASP
Define and govern API contracts, integration standards, and data flow between services and external systems
Guide and mentor development teams on architectural decisions, design patterns, coding standards, and technical debt management
Assess feasibility and trade-offs of proposed solutions and explain them clearly to technical and business stakeholders
Participate in pre-sales and proposal activities: contribute architecture sections, technical estimates, and solution design for client-facing bids and technical audiences
Design and integrate AI/LLM-powered capabilities into backend systems - including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, vector search, prompt/response handling, and integration with LLM providers or self-hosted models
Define data architecture for AI use cases: ingestion, chunking, embedding, and retrieval pipelines, along with the data governance and access controls around them
Evaluate build-vs-buy and vendor decisions for AI tooling (LLM APIs, vector databases, orchestration frameworks) based on client requirements, cost, and data sensitivity
Apply security and compliance thinking specific to AI systems: data leakage risks, prompt injection, access control on retrieved content, and responsible handling of client data used in AI pipelines

Skills & Experience

Hands-on backend software development experience, with at least 2-3 years in an architect or technical lead capacity
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)
Strong command of at least one major backend ecosystem (e.g., Java/Spring, .NET, or Python) and the ability to reason across others
Solid experience designing distributed systems, RESTful and/or event-driven APIs, and data models (relational and NoSQL)
Practical experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure) and cloud-native architecture (containers, orchestration)
Working knowledge of application and infrastructure security principles
Understanding of non-functional requirements: scalability, availability, performance, and resilience/failover design
Working understanding of LLM-based architectures: how RAG pipelines, embeddings, and vector search fit into a backend system, and how to integrate LLM APIs or self-hosted models into production services
Ability to assess, explain and draw existing systems and propose plans for incremental migration or rewriting
Strong communication and documentation skills (able to explain architectural decisions to both engineers and business/client stakeholders)
Comfortable working directly with clients: requirements gathering, technical workshops, and presenting solutions to steering committees or non-technical audiences
Willingness to travel to customer sites and events as required

Nice to Have

Exposure to frontend architecture (React, Angular, or similar) sufficient to guide full-stack integration decisions, even if not hands-on
Familiarity with security-specific tooling or practices: penetration testing basics, vulnerability scanning, or compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR-related technical controls)
Hands-on experience building or productionizing RAG systems, agentic workflows, or AI copilots
Familiarity with vector databases and embedding models
Understanding of LLM evaluation, guardrails, and cost/latency optimization for production AI features
Experience fine-tuning or self-hosting open-weight models for cost or data-sensitive client environments
Prior involvement in technical pre-sales, RFP responses, or solution architecture for client proposals
Experience mentoring or leading distributed/remote development teams

We are looking for an Agentic AI Engineer

to turn artificial intelligence technologies into solutions for tangible business needs. You will actively contribute to the design and development of AI agents, enterprise knowledge assistants, RAG-based applications, document-processing solutions and AI-enabled software development workflows. Using Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Copilot Studio and related enterprise technologies, you will develop solutions that progress from proof of concept to production.

The role is not limited to model or prompt development. It covers the complete solution lifecycle, from validating technical feasibility to architecture and integration, from security and quality evaluation to production deployment and continuous improvement. The primary objective is to integrate AI technologies with enterprise systems and turn them into reliable, sustainable solutions that deliver measurable business value.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop single-agent and multi-agent architectures and agentic workflows.
Develop enterprise AI solutions using Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Copilot Studio and Microsoft Power Platform.

Develop secure tool and function-calling integrations that enable agents to communicate with enterprise systems, REST APIs, data sources and business workflows.
Develop Document AI solutions capable of processing PDFs, Word documents, Excel files and other unstructured enterprise content.
Validate the technical feasibility and potential business value of AI use cases through focused prototypes and comparative studies.
Compare models and solution architectures based on response quality, task-completion performance, latency, security and operating cost.
Incorporate human-in-the-loop controls, authorization, approvals, stop conditions, fallback strategies and rollback mechanisms into agent workflows.
Work on prompt and context management, model selection, token usage, latency and cost optimization.
Integrate the principles of KVKK compliance, Responsible AI and enterprise information security throughout the solution lifecycle.
Develop solutions that support the controlled use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code and Kiro across software design, coding, testing, documentation and code-review processes.
Collaborate with software, data, security, infrastructure, product and business teams to move solutions from PoC to UAT and production.
Document architectural decisions, integrations, solution behaviour, technical limitations and operational requirements.
Contribute to shared AI platform standards by developing reusable prompts, agents, connectors, evaluation assets and orchestration components.
Monitor production AI solutions after deployment and continuously improve them based on user feedback, quality metrics, failure analysis and business outcomes.
Keep up to date with emerging GenAI, Agentic AI and LLM technologies and evaluate their applicability to enterprise needs.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Artificial Intelligence or a related engineering discipline.
At least five years of professional experience in engineering roles.
Hands-on development experience with LLM, Generative AI or agent-based solutions, including experience taking at least one solution into a pilot or production environment.
Application development experience with at least one of the following technologies: Python or .NET.
Knowledge and experience in REST APIs, SQL, relational data structures, authentication and authorization.

.NET-serverbeheer (IIS / Windows Server)

at AG SOLUTION, you will design the technical backbone of digital manufacturing solutions. You will work at the intersection of MES, automation, IIoT, data platforms, and the Unified Namespace (UNS) concept, helping shape scalable, future-proof architectures for our clients.

You will:

Architecture & Solution Design

Define end-to-end digital manufacturing architectures, covering MES, UNS, edge/OT layers, data integration, and cloud/on-prem components.
Design modular, scalable and secure architectures that support real-time operations, analytics, and cross-system connectivity.
Translate business and process requirements into technical designs, data models, and integration patterns.
Develop UNS structures (MQTT / Sparkplug / event-driven architectures), ensuring clean naming conventions, governance, and interoperability.
Define how MES, historians, SCADA/PLC, and enterprise systems (ERP, LIMS, QMS) communicate.

Technical Leadership

Provide technical guidance to project teams (MES consultants, automation engineers, data engineers, developers).
Review and validate functional & technical designs, ensuring alignment with the architectural vision.
Support implementation by offering hands-on expertise when needed (prototyping, integration, troubleshooting).
Coach teams and clients to adopt modern industrial IT/OT design principles.

Collaboration & Strategy

Facilitate workshops with stakeholders to explore requirements and align on architectural decisions.
Support clients in building digital transformation roadmaps — focusing on value, resilience, maintainability, and long-term scalability.
Contribute to AG SOLUTION’s internal knowledge base, best practices, and reference architectures.

Quality, Security & Governance

Ensure architectures comply with cybersecurity, data governance, and reliability standards.
Promote modern practices: event-driven architectures, decoupled integration, domain-based modelling, and clean data flows.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
Full Stack Engineer (Dutch speaking)
jobs.description:
👋 Wie we zijn
Bij Nimble bouwen we hoogwaardige digitale producten die het leven van mensen makkelijker maken. Geen poeha, geen jargon, gewoon slimme, intuïtieve tools die echte problemen oplossen. Of het nu gaat om een nieuw fintech-platform, een dashboard voor de zorgsector of een intern tool voor een scale-up: we helpen bedrijven snel van idee naar impact.
We zijn een hecht team van designers, developers en strategen, gevestigd in Gent, en werken hybride. Je brengt de helft van je dagen door in ons gezellig kantoor in de buurt van het stadscentrum, en de andere helft waar jij het beste werkt. Als Full-Stack Engineer sta je middenin het geheel: je vormt, bouwt en shipt producten die onder de motorkap robuust zijn en aan de oppervlakte fijn om te gebruiken. Je beweegt vlot tussen front-end en back-end en zorgt dat alles naadloos samenwerkt.

💼 Wat ga je doen
Je neemt ownership over de volledige stack: van slick UI's tot betrouwbare API's en databases.
Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met product designers en PM's, zodat wat je bouwt technisch sterk staat én gebruiksvriendelijk is.
Je helpt nieuwe producten mee opstarten met de juiste setup en tools, zodat schaalbaarheid er vanaf dag één in zit.
Je valideert en verfijnt je oplossingen door samen te werken met teamleden, grondig te testen en snel te itereren.
Je blijft op de hoogte van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen in webdevelopment en experimenteert met moderne frameworks, libraries en AI-tools wanneer het zinvol is.
Je deelt je perspectief met klanten, daagt ideeën constructief uit en toont je werk met trots.
Je bent een teamplayer: je geeft en ontvangt feedback, begeleidt andere developers en draagt bij aan herbruikbare code en documentatie.

🧠 Wie jij bent
Een full-stack engineer met minstens 5 jaar relevante ervaring.
Je voelt je thuis in zowel front-end (React, TypeScript, Tailwind…) als back-end (Node, API's, databases…).
Je bent nieuwsgierig naar AI en staat te popelen om te ontdekken hoe je het kan toepassen in echte digitale producten.
Iemand die floreert in een agile, iteratieve omgeving en niet bang is om vanaf nul te beginnen.
Je spreekt vloeiend Engels en Nederlands.
Je gelooft dat feedback brandstof is voor groei — je geeft het eerlijk en ontvangt het open.
Je wordt gedreven door impact: je wil dingen bouwen die mensen écht gebruiken en die er écht toe doen.

🎁 Wat wij jou bieden
Wij geloven in een werkplek waar mensen fantastisch werk kunnen leveren en tegelijk plezier beleven aan de rit. Dit is wat we bieden:
💰 Je loon bij Nimble is gebaseerd op de ownership die je opneemt en de impact die je creëert.
🏡 Hybride setup: 3 dagen op ons kantoor in Gent, 2 dagen van thuis uit.
🧘 Jaarlijkse sluiting tussen Kerst en Nieuwjaar, want rust voedt creativiteit.
🧠 Mentale ondersteuning via een toegewijde externe partner.
👾 Bouw en experimenteer met een moderne stack: Mastra, Qdrant of PGVector, Expo en Terraform.
💪🏻 Sport wanneer je maar wil bij "Healthworks Gym" om de hoek.
💻 Topmateriaal: MacBook, monitor, de volledige uitrusting.
📚 Jaarlijks budget voor learning & research & development: boeken, cursussen, events, jij kiest.
✈️ Jaarlijkse teamtrip: samen plezier maken, brainstormen en out-of-the-box denken.
🏥 Privéhospitalisatieverzekering (Alan).

🙌 Klinkt dit als jou? Denk je dat je waarde kan toevoegen bij Nimble? Dan horen we graag van je. Ook als je ervaring niet elk vakje afvinkt: solliciteer gerust. We zijn altijd benieuwd om mensen te ontmoeten die iets unieks meebrengen. Is er een klik? Dan zoeken we er samen wel uit.

🌈 Wij zijn een gelijkekansenwerkgever.
Bij Nimble verwelkomen we iedereen, van alle achtergronden, levenswandels en identiteiten. We geloven dat een divers team ons helpt betere, meer menselijke producten te bouwen.
We moedigen sollicitaties van ondervertegenwoordigde groepen in tech en gemarginaliseerde gemeenschappen sterk aan: vrouwen, mensen van kleur, LGBTQIA+'ers, ouders, mensen die van carrière veranderen, vluchtelingen, mensen met een beperking… wie je ook bent, jij hoort hier thuis.
Alle kandidaten worden beoordeeld zonder rekening te houden met ras, religie, genderidentiteit of -expressie, seksuele geaardheid, nationale afkomst, neurodiversiteit, beperking, leeftijd, of iets anders dat niets te maken heeft met je talent en potentieel.

Gent, België

Unser Rocken Partner ist führend in der telemedizinischen Versorgung und verbindet ärztliche Behandlung mit innovativen digitalen Lösungen. Hier arbeiten Ärzte, IT-Spezialisten und Gesundheitsexperten Hand in Hand, um Patientinnen und Patienten jederzeit Zugang zu hochwertiger medizinischer Beratung zu ermöglichen. Das Tätigkeitsfeld umfasst die Weiterentwicklung digitaler Gesundheitsplattformen, die Organisation telemedizinischer Dienstleistungen sowie die Zusammenarbeit mit einem breiten medizinischen Netzwerk. Der Fokus liegt auf Qualität, Effizienz und Patientenorientierung. Flache Hierarchien und interdisziplinäre Teams prägen den Arbeitsalltag. Innovation und medizinische Exzellenz stehen im Zentrum. Bereit, die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten? Dann freut sich unser Rocken Partner auf deine Bewerbung!

Rolle

Du übernimmst als Software Architect eine zentrale Rolle in einem komplexen technischen Ökosystem, das verschiedene Plattformen und Komponenten umfasst. In dieser Rolle verantwortest du die Konsistenz des gesamten Ökosystems und triffst wichtige Entscheidungen, die mehrere Teams betreffen. Du arbeitest eng mit Engineering-Teams zusammen und übst ein technisches Vetorecht bei Architekturentscheidungen aus. Deine Aufgabe ist es, technisch fundierte Lösungen zu finden und gleichzeitig die Zustimmung aller Beteiligten zu gewinnen. Du bist somit ein wichtiger Ansprechpartner für Product Owner, Business-Stakeholder und andere Bereiche, um gemeinsam Zielkonflikte zu lösen.

Verantwortung

Du arbeitest frühzeitig im Anforderungsprozess mit und zeigst auf, welchen Entwicklungs- und Betriebsaufwand die verschiedenen Optionen mit sich bringen
In dieser Rolle stimmst du Entscheidungen zu Architektur, Security und Datenresidenz mit dem internen Compliance-Team ab
