Du pflegst einen schlanken, kontinuierlich weiterentwickelten Bestand an gemeinsamen technischen Standards und dokumentierten Architekturentscheidungen

Qualifikationen

Du hast einen Hochschulabschluss in Informatik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet oder eine vergleichbare berufliche Qualifikation und Erfahrung
Du bringst mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung im Software Engineering sowie nachweisliche Erfahrung in Architekturrollen oder in der teamübergreifenden technischen Führung mit
Du hast ausreichend praktische Erfahrung mit modernen Backend- und Web-Technologien, um konkrete Implementierungsentscheidungen fundiert hinterfragen zu können
Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit serverseitigem GraphQL, einschliesslich Schema Composition
Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Data & Analytics, Datenflüsse, Cloud-Infrastruktur und Security
Du hast fliessende Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Experience with JIRA and TestRail or similar test management tools.

Team player
Problem solving
Curious

jobs.location: Sant Cugat del Vallès, Catalonia, Spain
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are

At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

The Opportunity

You will be joining one of the Agile organisations in charge of designing, implementing, delivering and maintaining Reusable solution to simplify interoperability between diagnostics solutions (Roche and non-Roche instrumentation, LIS, HIS, Edge Systems…) to simplify the development to reduce complexity, time to market, cost of ownership and quality of our internal customers within R&D Departments at Roche Diagnostics.

This position will play a critical role in the team, leveraging deep expertise in Connectivity protocols and solutions and supporting the design, development, deployment and validation of future connectivity solutions while maintaining the current base of deployments across Roche. As a Software Engineer, you will be also lead the ASDLC adoption and Ways of working in your team while preserving quality standards and good software practices. You are expected to show a good customer centric mindset.

For this you will prove experience in .NET Software Development, Instrument connectivity protocols and Interoperability in general. You can communicate effectively in English with people of different profiles, cultures and your mentoring skills shall contribute to continuous improvement and delivering excellent software efficiently.

You will be responsible

You care about your team, leading technical discussions and complex initiatives. You can influence decisions within your area of responsibility and connect naturally with business and architecture representatives to provide solutions to our customers. You are able to manage technology, business and reality to design future feasible and efficient solutions.

Who you are:

Healthcare Interoperability & Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of healthcare and laboratory integration standards (e.g., HL7, POCT1-A, ASTM, LIS/HIS) and connectivity solutions for diagnostics environments
Software Development & Quality Practices: Proven hands-on C# .NET development background with strong expertise in software design patterns, object-oriented design, TDD/BDD, unit/integration testing, and maintainable code
End-to-End Ownership & AI Integration: Track record of full SDLC responsibility (from requirements to deployment), including integrating AI toolsets into development workflows and understanding cloud/frontend technologies
Technical Leadership & Architecture: Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor developers, design robust components, and guide architecture/AI strategy alongside product managers and stakeholders
Education, Communication & Soft Skills: Degree in CS or related field (Bachelor's + 6 years or Master's + 4 years), with strong problem-solving skills, independence, and fluent communication in English and Spanish for agile, cross-functional collaboration

Locations

You will be based in Sant Cugat, Spain.

Leadership Skills

You are also responsible for building, and then providing effective leadership for your team. Doing so in a manner that is consistent with the Roche Values and leadership capabilities. You will seek to inspire and lead your team to create transformative solutions, and to influence their prioritization and uptake in the wider organization, in order to ensure that customer solutions are at the forefront of the market and deliver its optimal contribution to the Roche Diagnostics Vision.

Both Diagnostics and Diabetes Care Leadership teams use these skills when referring to leadership. Consider bringing them into the job description.

The Expert SW Engineer in Mobile is expected to demonstrate the Roche Operating Principles and contribute to the Roche Group. The Roche Operating Principles are:

Put patients first
Follow the science
Act as one team
Embrace differences
Accelerate learning
Simplify radically
Make impact now
Think long term

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

En ALTEN tenemos claro que el éxito de nuestros proyectos se debe a las personas que forman nuestro equipo. Por eso, si tienes experiencia como Ingeniero/a en Software especializado/a en diseño, desarrollo e integración de soluciones de gestión de identidades y accesos (IAM)
, nos comprometemos a impulsar tu talento, satisfacer tus expectativas laborales y hacerte sentir como en casa.

¿Quieres construir hoy el mundo de mañana?
¡Sigue leyendo!

¿Cuáles serían tus principales funciones?

Diseño, desarrollo e integración de aplicaciones, servicios y componentes software relacionados con la gestión de identidades y accesos (IAM)
, en entornos que combinan tecnologías legadas de entornos Windows y estándares y arquitecturas modernas de autenticación, autorización y federación de identidades.

¿Qué buscamos?

Grado en Telecomunicaciones, Informática o similar.
Más de 2 años de experiencia en diseño, desarrollo e integración de soluciones IAM.
Inglés nivel B2 (alto).

Conocimientos técnicos:

Identidad digital, credenciales, autenticación y autorización.
Gestión de usuarios, grupos, roles, perfiles y permisos.
Lenguajes: C# (.NET), Python, Java.

¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?

Incorporación a una empresa multinacional competitiva en continuo crecimiento.
Integración en un equipo de profesionales altamente cualificado, con un buen clima laboral, innovador y dinámico.
Formación especializada y desarrollo profesional continuo.

¿Quiénes somos?

Somos un equipo. Formamos parte de ALTEN, una multinacional europea especializada en proporcionar servicios de consultoría, tecnología de la información y servicios de ingeniería a las principales compañías del mercado español.

Si te gustan las cifras, te diremos que en España tenemos una facturación de 337 millones de euros, 10 sedes y un equipo formado por 5.500 personas.

Además, en ALTEN nos enorgullecemos de ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades con independencia de género, edad, diversidad de capacidades o país de origen. Nuestro compromiso está con el talento y con las personas que lo tienen.

Si crees que eres talento, ¡apúntate!🚀

jobs.description:
En Arelance sabemos que las personas son el activo más importante dentro de una empresa y por tanto invertimos muchos esfuerzos en buscar los mejores profesionales para nuestros clientes, y en ofrecer a nuestros candidatos los mejores proyectos.

Buscamos un/a Technical Architect especializado/a en Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O)
para liderar técnicamente proyectos de implantación y evolución de la plataforma. La persona seleccionada será responsable de definir la arquitectura técnica de las soluciones, liderar workshops con clientes y equipos funcionales, supervisar desarrollos e integraciones y garantizar la calidad técnica durante todo el ciclo de vida del proyecto.

Funciones

Liderar la definición de la arquitectura técnica
de proyectos basados en Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
Participar en todas las fases del proyecto: análisis, diseño, desarrollo, pruebas, despliegue y puesta en producción.
Liderar workshops técnicos y sesiones de diseño
con clientes, usuarios clave, Business SMEs y equipos de desarrollo.
Analizar requisitos y traducirlos en soluciones técnicas alineadas con las necesidades del negocio, los objetivos de rendimiento y la estrategia tecnológica del cliente.
Diseñar arquitecturas de integración entre D365 F&O y sistemas externos
, definiendo APIs, servicios, flujos de datos y patrones de integración.
Definir estrategias de migración y conversión de datos
, incluyendo el uso de Data Management Framework y diferentes mecanismos de integración.
Diseñar soluciones de extensibilidad y personalización de D365 F&O, garantizando el uso adecuado del modelo de extensiones.
Participar en el diseño de seguridad, reporting, Power BI, integraciones con Azure y soluciones basadas en Power Platform
.
Definir arquitecturas de entornos, estrategias de despliegue y procesos de CI/CD
.
Supervisar técnicamente al equipo de desarrollo y revisar la calidad de los desarrollos realizados.
Definir estándares, buenas prácticas y procedimientos técnicos para garantizar la consistencia de los entregables.
Elaborar documentación técnica, solution designs, blueprints, diagramas de arquitectura, integraciones y flujos de datos.
Coordinar y proporcionar soporte técnico a equipos de desarrollo onsite, onshore y offshore
.
Garantizar que las soluciones cumplen los estándares técnicos definidos hasta la entrega del sistema.
Aplicar y promover metodologías Agile
y buenas prácticas de desarrollo dentro del equipo técnico.

Requisitos

Titulación universitaria en Informática, Ingeniería, Tecnologías de la Información
o similar.
7-10 años de experiencia
trabajando con Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
Experiencia demostrable como Technical Architect
en al menos 3 implantaciones end-to-end de D365 F&O
.
Certificación vigente Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365: Finance and Operations Apps Solution Architect Expert
.
Sólidos conocimientos de D365 F&O, Lifecycle Services (LCS) y Azure DevOps
, incluyendo control de código fuente, gated check-ins y pipelines.
Experiencia avanzada en X++, .NET, C# y servicios web
(REST, SOAP y OData).
Conocimientos sólidos de Microsoft Azure
, incluyendo Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, API Management, Blob Storage y Table Storage.
Experiencia con Power Apps, Power Platform, Common Data Service/Dataverse y Azure Data Lake
.
Experiencia diseñando integraciones síncronas y asíncronas
y trabajando con servicios personalizados y diferentes mecanismos de integración de D365 F&O.
Experiencia con Data Management Framework
, BYOD, recurring integrations/jobs y procesos de migración y conversión de datos.
Conocimiento de estrategias de extensibilidad de D365 F&O
, evitando el overlayering y aplicando el modelo de extensiones.
Experiencia en diseño y personalización de seguridad basada en roles
y Extensible Data Security.
Experiencia con reporting y Power BI
, tanto embebido como externo.
Conocimientos de Azure Licensing y arquitectura cloud
.
Experiencia con Git, control de versiones y pipelines CI/CD

Capacidad para elaborar diseños técnicos, blueprints, diagramas de arquitectura, integración y flujos de datos.
Experiencia liderando equipos técnicos y supervisando desarrolladores.

Brains, bytes and bold ideas.

ser la referencia técnica del pod en el Run de 15 sitios Drupal: upgrades de versión, activación de funcionalidades en nuevos países, regresiones por el upgrade de activeWhere y flujo de bugs. Después, tomar tickets de Build.

5+ años en Drupal, con Drupal 10 en producción

Configuration management avanzado (CMI)

Experiencia en Drupal Commerce
o en e-commerce sobre Drupal: carrito, checkout, precios, pedidos recurrentes.

, y flujos de pasarelas de pago (webhooks, estados de pago).
Pull requests con revisión obligatoria, phpcs / Drupal coding standards
y tests unitarios (PHPUnit)
.

Pantheon (Terminus, Quicksilver, dev/test/live), ddev, Redis y Solr.
Azure DevOps (boards, repos, pipelines).
Upgrades de versión mayor de Drupal sobre plataformas con muchos módulos propios.

Proporcionar liderazgo técnico y orientación a los equipos de desarrollo durante todo el ciclo de vida del proyecto.
Actuar como asesor técnico y experto en la materia para los proyectos asignados.

Crear y mantener la documentación arquitectónica, incluyendo diagramas de flujo, diagramas de componentes, especificaciones de diseño y otros artefactos relevantes.

Asegurar que las soluciones cumplan con las políticas de seguridad, cumplimiento y gobernanza de la empresa.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Company

The Best of Both Worlds

At Maisa, we believe great work happens when people have the freedom to choose the setup that works best for them.

Prefer the flexibility of remote work?

You’re welcome to work remotely. Most of our roles are currently focused on Spain, although depending on the position and profile, we may be open to hiring from other locations.

Looking for some social energy?

Our hybrid setup gives you the option to connect and work alongside teammates at our hubs in Valencia, Barcelona, Madrid and Murcia

. And as we grow, our spaces will grow with us: when we build a team of more than 10 people in a location, our ambition is to create a hub there too.

We also want the time we spend together in person to be worth it. Today, that includes weekly transportation from the city center to our Valencia headquarters

and weekly team lunches in Valencia and Barcelona

, with more experiences to come as our teams and hubs evolve.

The Culture is OURS to Create

We’re still shaping how we work together—and that’s part of what makes joining Maisa now specifically exciting.

Everyone who joins has the opportunity to influence how we collaborate, connect, and build our culture. Rather than inheriting a finished playbook, you’ll have a voice in creating it.

Remote when you want flexibility. Together when you want connection. And a culture you can help shape from day one.

Welcome to Maisa – Making AI Accountable!

Maisa is building the next generation of Agentic Process Automation
, helping enterprises automate complex, decision-heavy processes that traditional automation can’t handle and GenAI alone can’t be trusted with. Our platform combines AI-driven reasoning with deterministic execution, enabling reliable, auditable, and enterprise-ready AI systems.

About The Role…

We’re seeking Forward Deployed Engineers to work at the intersection of engineering, product, and customers, deploying and adapting Maisa Studio
, our flagship Agentic Process Automation platform, to solve real-world enterprise problems.

Customer-Facing Engineering
Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their processes and goals. Design and implement solutions using Maisa Studio to automate complex workflows, acting as a trusted technical partner during onboarding and deployment while translating requirements into technical implementations and product feedback.

Collaboration & Product Feedback
Partner with product and engineering teams to influence roadmap development. Surface customer needs, edge cases, and scalability concerns while defining best practices, reference architectures, and reusable components that accelerate delivery.

Reliability, Security & Quality
Ensure deployments meet enterprise standards for reliability, performance, and security. Support customers in regulated environments by aligning with compliance requirements and collaborating with QA, SRE, and AppSec teams for stable rollouts.

What You’ll Do…

You will work closely with enterprise customers and internal teams to deliver robust, secure, and maintainable deployments in complex, often regulated environments, across 2 key technical domains:

Integrations & Supporting Services (Build what makes the use case work)

Configure, extend, and integrate Maisa Studio into customer environments, designing end-to-end solutions that include APIs, connectors, webhooks, serverless functions, microservices, and event-driven flows. Translate functional requirements from Automators and Technical Account Managers into concrete technical implementations using Go, Python, or JavaScript, clarifying ambiguities and proposing pragmatic paths forward. Ensure robustness through strong engineering practices including testing, logging, monitoring, and documentation. Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and support handover to internal teams or customers when applicable.

Customer Infrastructure Deployments / DevOps (On-prem & Customer Cloud)

Design and support deployments of Maisa Studio in customer environments, including on-premise and customer-managed cloud infrastructures. Work closely with customer DevOps, SRE, and Security teams to achieve production readiness, configuring platform requirements including authentication (OIDC, SAML), IAM, networking (VPNs, DNS, ingress/egress), and operational controls (deployment pipelines, monitoring, backups, high availability). Diagnose and resolve deployment-level incidents, ensure the platform operates within customer security and compliance requirements, and produce clear operational documentation including runbooks, deployment patterns, and troubleshooting guides.

What You’ll Bring…

You have strong experience as a Software Engineer, Solutions Engineer, DevOps/SRE Engineer, or Forward Deployed Engineer in customer-facing or delivery-oriented roles. You're comfortable operating in ambiguous environments, moving quickly from problem to solution while maintaining reliability, with strong troubleshooting skills across code, integrations, and infrastructure. You bring a customer-first mindset and can explain technical concepts clearly to drive alignment.

We are seeking candidates with one of two skill sets, or a mix of both:

Integrations & Supporting Services (Build what makes the use case work)

Strong experience as a backend or full-stack developer shipping production systems.
Hands-on experience with APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures/queues.
Familiarity with serverless and integration patterns commonly used in enterprise environments.
Strong debugging skills and comfort operating across code, infrastructure touchpoints, and workflow logic.

Customer Infrastructure Deployments / DevOps (On-prem & Customer Cloud)

Strong experience in DevOps / SRE, supporting production workloads.
Hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes, cloud providers and/or on-prem infrastructure, and networking fundamentals.
Practical experience with security and identity standards: OIDC, SAML, VPNs, certificates, and IAM concepts.
Ability to quickly understand customer infrastructure and adapt to their tools and processes.
Clear, structured communication with technical stakeholders in customer organizations.

Why join Maisa!

You will be joining one of Europe’s most exciting early-stage AI start-ups, where you’ll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge Agentic Process Automation that’s reshaping how enterprises approach AI deployment. You will get to directly influence how major multinational organizations transform critical business processes, working on genuinely differentiated technology that solves real enterprise AI challenges.

Following our recent $25m Seed Round, backed by leading Venture Capital firms including Creandum, Forgepoint, NFX, and Village Global, we’re scaling quickly and realising significant enterprise traction. This is your opportunity to help solve real AI enterprise challenges, working alongside deep technical and industry experts, where you will be challenged daily and expedite your learning and development.

Maisa is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all.

By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

Configure, extend, and integrate Maisa Studio into customer environments, designing end-to-end solutions that include APIs, connectors, webhooks, serverless functions, microservices, and event-driven flows. Translate functional requirements from Automators and Technical Account Managers into concrete technical implementations using Go, Python, or JavaScript, clarifying ambiguities and proposing pragmatic paths forward. Ensure robustness through strong engineering practices including testing, logging, monitoring, and documentation. Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and support handover to internal teams or customers when applicable.

Customer Infrastructure Deployments / DevOps (On-prem & Customer Cloud)

Design and support deployments of Maisa Studio in customer environments, including on-premise and customer-managed cloud infrastructures. Work closely with customer DevOps, SRE, and Security teams to achieve production readiness, configuring platform requirements including authentication (OIDC, SAML), IAM, networking (VPNs, DNS, ingress/egress), and operational controls (deployment pipelines, monitoring, backups, high availability). Diagnose and resolve deployment-level incidents, ensure the platform operates within customer security and compliance requirements, and produce clear operational documentation including runbooks, deployment patterns, and troubleshooting guides.

What You’ll Bring…

You have strong experience as a Software Engineer, Solutions Engineer, DevOps/SRE Engineer, or Forward Deployed Engineer in customer-facing or delivery-oriented roles. You're comfortable operating in ambiguous environments, moving quickly from problem to solution while maintaining reliability, with strong troubleshooting skills across code, integrations, and infrastructure. You bring a customer-first mindset and can explain technical concepts clearly to drive alignment.

We are seeking candidates with one of two skill sets, or a mix of both:

Integrations & Supporting Services (Build what makes the use case work)

Strong experience as a backend or full-stack developer shipping production systems.
Hands-on experience with APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures/queues.
Familiarity with serverless and integration patterns commonly used in enterprise environments.
Strong debugging skills and comfort operating across code, infrastructure touchpoints, and workflow logic.

Customer Infrastructure Deployments / DevOps (On-prem & Customer Cloud)

Strong experience in DevOps / SRE, supporting production workloads.
Hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes, cloud providers and/or on-prem infrastructure, and networking fundamentals.
Practical experience with security and identity standards: OIDC, SAML, VPNs, certificates, and IAM concepts.
Ability to quickly understand customer infrastructure and adapt to their tools and processes.
Clear, structured communication with technical stakeholders in customer organizations.

Why join Maisa!

You will be joining one of Europe’s most exciting early-stage AI start-ups, where you’ll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge Agentic Process Automation that’s reshaping how enterprises approach AI deployment. You will get to directly influence how major multinational organizations transform critical business processes, working on genuinely differentiated technology that solves real enterprise AI challenges.

Following our recent $25m Seed Round, backed by leading Venture Capital firms including Creandum, Forgepoint, NFX, and Village Global, we’re scaling quickly and realising significant enterprise traction. This is your opportunity to help solve real AI enterprise challenges, working alongside deep technical and industry experts, where you will be challenged daily and expedite your learning and development.

Maisa is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all.

Build your future with Sovos.

If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionising how businesses navigate the ever-changing regulatory landscape.

At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.

Our purpose-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!

Don’t worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway. We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

The Work You'll Do

At Sovos, our Core Platform and AI Platform
are the foundation that dozens of engineering teams build on. We're seeking a Fullstack Senior Engineer
who will design, build, and operate the platform services that power that foundation — services that are reliable, well-documented, and adoptable at scale.

This is a builder role at the center of the Sovos platform strategy. You'll work closely with the Platform Adoption
team to understand how teams are using what you build, close feedback loops quickly, and ensure that what ships is something the broader engineering organization can confidently rely on.

The Fullstack Senior Engineer
will own the design and delivery of platform services that span the Sovos portfolio — from identity and administration to AI capabilities and shared infrastructure
. Your work directly determines what other teams can build and how fast they can build it
.

More Specifically You Will

Building Platform Services That Scale Across the Portfolio

You'll design and deliver the Core Platform and AI Platform services that product teams depend on — things like identity, shared admin experiences, design system components, and AI infrastructure. As an AI Architect, you will design and guide production-ready Generative AI solutions for clients, from early discovery through implementation. This role combines hands-on architecture, technical leadership, and client collaboration. You will help teams choose where Generative AI adds value, build secure and scalable solutions, and measure their quality and cost in production.

Solution Architecture & Delivery

Define the right adaptation approach for each use case—prompting, RAG, fine-tuning, or distillation—including when Generative AI is not appropriate.

AI Quality, Security & Operations

Own evaluation strategy, including golden datasets, offline and online evaluation, human-calibrated LLM-as-judge, and CI regression testing.
Set retrieval quality standards for chunking, hybrid search, reranking, query rewriting, and permission-aware retrieval, using measured recall and precision.
Define AI security, privacy, Responsible AI, and governance controls, including prompt injection, data exfiltration, jailbreak, sandboxing, least-privilege identity, and supply-chain risks.
Own solution economics through model routing, caching, batching, capacity planning, and defensible cost-per-transaction estimates.
Support enterprise architecture standards and help assess technology solutions.

Leadership, Clients & Practice

Supervise vendor developers and mentor engineers and junior architects.
Support business development by identifying and researching opportunities with new and existing clients.
Improve internal design and development practices and maintain documentation.
Build internal relationships, strengthen the firm's reputation, and develop your skills in line with company and team priorities.
Take on additional responsibilities relevant to the role and agreed with your manager.

Experience

What You'll Bring

5+ years of experience in agile product delivery.
Hands-on experience designing and delivering production software solutions at scale.
Demonstrated expertise in Generative AI solution architecture.
You have personally delivered at least one Generative AI system to production and can explain its architecture, failure modes, operating costs, and lessons learned.

Education & Certifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Relevant Microsoft Azure certification, such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Developer Associate, is preferred.

Technical Skills & Specialized Knowledge

Strong hands-on experience with Generative AI architecture is essential. Experience across several relevant technologies is expected; expertise in every named tool is not required.

Generative AI & Agent Architecture

Large language models such as GPT-4, Gemini, and Llama.
RAG, agent orchestration, and Microsoft Copilots using platforms or frameworks such as Azure OpenAI Service, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
Vector search and retrieval engineering, including chunking, hybrid search, reranking, query rewriting, metadata filtering, and permission-aware retrieval.
Production AI agents, including tool calls, state and memory management, durable execution, approval controls, retries, idempotency, and cost safeguards.
Structured generation, including schema-enforced outputs, validation and repair, deterministic fallbacks, and graceful degradation.

Cloud, Software & Data Engineering

Cloud-native Azure architecture, including Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI services, and appropriate infrastructure and platform services.
Service-oriented, event-driven, and microservices architectures.
Relational and NoSQL data stores, such as Microsoft SQL Server and MongoDB, with sound technology-selection judgement.
Containers and orchestration using Docker and/or Kubernetes.
DevOps and delivery practices, including CI/CD, automation, environment management, and tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub, or Jira.
Working knowledge of user-centred product practices, including user stories, personas, and prototyping.

Evaluation, Operations & Security

AI evaluation using golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, and prompt and model regression testing.
LLMOps and observability, including tracing, token and cost attribution, prompt and model versioning, trace replay, and quality-drift monitoring, using tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, or Azure Monitor.
Model economics, including routing, cascading, caching, batching, and provisioned-versus-consumption capacity planning.
AI security, including prompt injection, data exfiltration, jailbreak resistance, sandboxing, least-privilege identities, supply-chain risk, and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

Nice to Have

Model Context Protocol and agent interoperability standards.
Model adaptation beyond prompting and RAG, including fine-tuning, LoRA/PEFT, and distillation.
Multimodal AI, including document intelligence, vision, speech, or voice agents.
AI regulation and assurance frameworks, including the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, and NIST AI RMF.
Consulting or professional-services experience with external clients.

Strategic, analytical problem-solving with attention to detail.
Leadership, troubleshooting, curiosity, and creativity.
Fluent written and spoken English.
Clear written and verbal communication with product teams, clients, and stakeholders.
Strong collaboration and client focus, with the ability to understand needs, use feedback, and support timely, high-quality delivery.

new_jobs.title: Azure Integration Architect / Presales Architect
new_jobs.description:
Innostutko asiakkaiden liiketoimintahaasteiden ratkaisemisesta moderneilla integraatio- ja pilvipalveluratkaisuilla? Viihdytkö liiketoiminnan, arkkitehtuurin ja asiakastyön rajapinnassa?

Sijainti: Suomi
Kokemustaso: Mid/Senior

Etsimme kokenutta Azure-integraatioarkkitehtia vahvistamaan Solitan integraatioliiketoimintaa Suomessa.

Roolin kuvaus

Tässä roolissa toimit asiakkaidemme luotettuna neuvonantajana ja osallistut integraatio- ja pilviratkaisujen suunnitteluun aina ensimmäisistä asiakaskeskusteluista toteutukseen asti.
Työssä korostuvat asiakkaiden kanssa työskentely sekä myynnin tukeminen. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, myynnin ja teknisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa ymmärtääksesi asiakkaan liiketoimintahaasteet ja muuntaaksesi ne toimiviksi, skaalautuviksi ja turvallisiksi Azure-pohjaisiksi ratkaisuiksi. Pystyt keskustelemaan sujuvasti liiketoimintajohdon kanssa asiakkaan tavoitteista ja haasteista sekä syventymään teknisiin ratkaisuihin arkkitehtien ja kehittäjien kanssa.

Integraatioarkkitehtina mahdollistat älykkään, turvallisen ja liiketoimintaa tukevan järjestelmien yhteentoimivuuden. Suunnittelet ja toteutat integraatioratkaisuja, joiden avulla data ja prosessit liikkuvat saumattomasti organisaation sisällä ja ekosysteemien välillä. Roolissasi yhdistyvät pitkäjänteinen arkkitehtuurityö, toimitusten sparraus sekä AI-avusteisten toimintamallien hyödyntäminen integraatioiden suunnittelussa, toteutuksessa, laadunvarmistuksessa ja dokumentoinnissa.

Johdat teknistä visiota siitä, kuinka järjestelmät kommunikoivat skaalautuvasti, hallitusti ja turvallisesti. Valitset sopivat integraatiomallit, teknologiat ja toimintatavat, määrittelet arkkitehtuuriperiaatteet ja varmistat, että ratkaisut tukevat sekä nykyisiä liiketoimintatarpeita että pidemmän aikavälin IT-strategiaa. Samalla huolehdit siitä, että integraatioiden operoitavuus, laatu, dokumentaatio ja hallintamallit ovat kestävällä pohjalla.

Keskitymme moderneihin API-ratkaisuihin, pilvipohjaisiin integraatioihin ja automaatioon valiten aina asiakkaalle parhaiten sopivat työkalut. Laatu ja parhaat käytännöt ohjaavat kaikkea tekemistämme, ja hyödynnämme aktiivisesti tekoälyä kehitystyön tehostamiseksi ja entistä parempien ratkaisujen tuottamiseksi.

Keskeisiä integraatioteknologioitamme ovat Azure, MuleSoft, Apache Camel. Työskentelemme myös Workaton ja Kafkan parissa. Meillä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisissa projekteissa sekä julkisella että yksityisellä sektorilla.

Kokemuksestasi ja vastuutasostasi riippuen kuukausipalkka tässä roolissa on 5 200–6 200 euroa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Vahva kokemus integraatioarkkitehtuurista ja yritystason integraatioratkaisuista
Kokemusta Microsoft Azure -ympäristöjen suunnittelusta ja hyödyntämisestä
Kykyä toimia sekä liiketoiminnan että teknisten sidosryhmien kanssa
Kokemusta työpajojen, vaatimusmäärittelyjen ja asiakaskeskustelujen fasilitoinnista
Ymmärrystä tekoälyn ja AI-agenttien hyödyntämisestä osana yritysarkkitehtuuria, integraatioita tai liiketoimintaprosesseja.
Erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja esiintymistaitoja suomeksi ja englanniksi
Kykyä muuntaa asiakkaan liiketoimintahaasteet konkreettisiksi teknisiksi ratkaisuiksi
Kokemusta myynnin tukemisesta ratkaisusuunnittelun, tarjousten ja asiakastapaamisten kautta
Ymmärrystä API-arkkitehtuureista, tapahtumapohjaisista ratkaisuista ja pilvinatiiveista integraatiomalleista
Konsultoivaa työotetta ja kykyä rakentaa luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita

Katsomme lisäksi eduksi

Kokemus Azure Integration Services -ratkaisuista
Kokemus API Management -alustoista
Ymmärrys data-, analytiikka- ja AI-ratkaisujen integraatiotarpeista
Kokemus laajojen arkkitehtuurikokonaisuuksien tai muutoshankkeiden johtamisesta
Microsoft Azure -sertifioinnit

Huomioithan, että useat asiakasprojektimme edellyttävät sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

Millainen henkilö menestyy tässä roolissa?

Viihdyt asiakkaiden kanssa ja nautit teknologian, liiketoiminnan sekä uusien mahdollisuuksien tunnistamisen yhdistämisestä.
Osaat keskustella asiakkaan johdon kanssa liiketoiminnan tavoitteista ja haasteista sekä toisaalta sparrata kehittäjiä ja arkkitehteja teknisissä ratkaisuissa. Näet arkkitehtuurin keinona luoda liiketoiminta-arvoa, et pelkästään teknisinä piirustuksina.
Olet oma-aloitteinen, kaupallisesti ajatteleva ja motivoidut asiakkaiden onnistumisesta sekä Solitan liiketoiminnan kasvattamisesta.

Miksi viihtyisit meillä?

Asiantuntijayhteisö

Osaajayhteisömme tarjoaa mahdollisuuden jatkuvaan oppimiseen ja ammatilliseen kehittymiseen. Arvostamme yhteistyötä ja vahvaa yhteisöllisyyttä projektien ja asiakkaiden välillä. Se on yksi tärkeimmistä syistä siihen, miksi ihmiset viihtyvät tiimissämme.
Vapautta ja joustavuutta

Solitalla työ mukautuu elämääsi, ei päinvastoin. Voit työskennellä mistä päin Suomea tahansa ja meillä on joustava etätyöpolitiikka, asiakastarve huomioiden.
Kattavat edut

Voit valita omat työvälineesi, hyödyntää laajaa työterveyshuoltoa, käyttää hierontaetua, pyöräetua, saada tukea sisäisiltä valmentajiltamme sekä osallistua erilaisiin harrastuskerhoihimme.
Kiinteä kuukausipalkka

Kannustamme oppimiseen, osaamisen kehittämiseen, yhteistyöhön ja tiedon jakamiseen ilman laskutusasteeseen perustuvaa palkitsemismallia.
Mahdollisuuksia kasvaa

Solita Growth Academy, mentorointi ja mahdollisuus siirtyä erilaisiin projekteihin tarjoavat jatkuvia mahdollisuuksia ammatilliseen kehittymiseen.
Vaikuttavia asiakasprojekteja

Olemme esimerkiksi auttaneet metsäkonevalmistaja Ponssea tehostamaan toimintaansa ja kasvattamaan palveluliiketoimintaansa toimittamalla modernin pilvipohjaisen data-alustan sekä integraatiot useisiin tietolähteisiin.

Haluatko liittyä Solitan integraatioyhteisöön?

Jos tämä kuulostaa sinulle sopivalta mahdollisuudelta, lähetä meille CV:si, LinkedIn-profiilisi tai hakemuksesi. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Saila Karonen (saila.karonen@solita.fi).

Keskeisenä teknologia-, data- ja designkumppanina Solitan liiketoiminta perustuu luottamukseen ja vastuullisuuteen. Tästä syystä valitun hakijan henkilöllisyys ja työhistoria tarkistetaan. Nämä tarkastukset suoritetaan työelämän yksityisyyden suojasta annetun lain mukaisesti ja sen rajoissa.
Tässä tehtävässä työskentely voi edellyttää asiakkaamme pyynnöstä tehtävää turvallisuusselvitystä. Turvallisuusselvitys toteutetaan turvallisuusselvityslain mukaisesti, ja sen hyväksytty läpäiseminen on tehtävässä työskentelyn edellytys.

new_jobs.title: Senior SW Engineer for POC
new_jobs.location: Sant Cugat del Vallès, Catalonia, Spain
new_jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are

At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

The Opportunity

You will be joining one of the Agile organisations in charge of designing, implementing, delivering and maintaining Reusable solution to simplify interoperability between diagnostics solutions (Roche and non-Roche instrumentation, LIS, HIS, Edge Systems…) to simplify the development to reduce complexity, time to market, cost of ownership and quality of our internal customers within R&D Departments at Roche Diagnostics.

This position will play a critical role in the team, leveraging deep expertise in Connectivity protocols and solutions and supporting the design, development, deployment and validation of future connectivity solutions while maintaining the current base of deployments across Roche. As a Software Engineer, you will be also lead the ASDLC adoption and Ways of working in your team while preserving quality standards and good software practices. You are expected to show a good customer centric mindset.

For this you will prove experience in .NET Software Development, Instrument connectivity protocols and Interoperability in general. You can communicate effectively in English with people of different profiles, cultures and your mentoring skills shall contribute to continuous improvement and delivering excellent software efficiently.

You will be responsible

You care about your team, leading technical discussions and complex initiatives. You can influence decisions within your area of responsibility and connect naturally with business and architecture representatives to provide solutions to our customers. You are able to manage technology, business and reality to design future feasible and efficient solutions.

Who you are:

Healthcare Interoperability & Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of healthcare and laboratory integration standards (e.g., HL7, POCT1-A, ASTM, LIS/HIS) and connectivity solutions for diagnostics environments
Software Development & Quality Practices: Proven hands-on C# .NET development background with strong expertise in software design patterns, object-oriented design, TDD/BDD, unit/integration testing, and maintainable code
End-to-End Ownership & AI Integration: Track record of full SDLC responsibility (from requirements to deployment), including integrating AI toolsets into development workflows and understanding cloud/frontend technologies
Technical Leadership & Architecture: Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor developers, design robust components, and guide architecture/AI strategy alongside product managers and stakeholders
Education, Communication & Soft Skills: Degree in CS or related field (Bachelor's + 6 years or Master's + 4 years), with strong problem-solving skills, independence, and fluent communication in English and Spanish for agile, cross-functional collaboration

Locations

You will be based in Sant Cugat, Spain.

Leadership Skills

You are also responsible for building, and then providing effective leadership for your team. Doing so in a manner that is consistent with the Roche Values and leadership capabilities. You will seek to inspire and lead your team to create transformative solutions, and to influence their prioritization and uptake in the wider organization, in order to ensure that customer solutions are at the forefront of the market and deliver its optimal contribution to the Roche Diagnostics Vision.

Both Diagnostics and Diabetes Care Leadership teams use these skills when referring to leadership. Consider bringing them into the job description.

The Expert SW Engineer in Mobile is expected to demonstrate the Roche Operating Principles and contribute to the Roche Group. The Roche Operating Principles are:

Put patients first
Follow the science
Act as one team
Embrace differences
Accelerate learning
Simplify radically
Make impact now
Think long term

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
